AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

==== 162 root.json
{
  "marker": "CharacterFlowFilms",
  "import": "import { CharacterFlowFilms } from \"./kits/characterflow/Films.tsx\";",
  "element": "<CharacterFlowFilms />"
}

==== 10848 scripts/make.mjs
// One command from a story spec to a checked video.
//   node scripts/make.mjs stories/<id>/story.json [--preview] [--final] [--stills=3.2,10,18] [--no-qa]
//
//   1. resolve   story.json (+ words.json) → src/stories/data/<id>.json, regenerate src/stories/registry.ts
//   2. direct    compile the story (blocking, acting, shots, sound cues) and print the plan; stops on errors
//   3. sound     scripts/sound-story.ts → public/audio/<id>-mix.wav
//   4. render    --preview: 540×960@30 with audio · --final (default): 1080×1920@60, mastered to −14 LUFS
//                (interrupted? run the same command again — finished segments are reused)
//   5. QA        scripts/qa.mjs → out/<id>/qa/ (contact sheets, frame scan, sync, duration)

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const file = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const flag = (k) => args.includes(`--${k}`);
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
// the director is TypeScript: Node 22.13–22.17 needs the strip-types flag (22.18+ has it on by default)
if (!process.features.typescript) {
  const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["--experimental-strip-types", "--no-warnings", ...process.argv.slice(1)], { stdio: "inherit" });
  process.exit(r.status ?? 1);
}
if (!file || !fs.existsSync(file)) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/make.mjs stories/<id>/story.json [--preview] [--final] [--stills=…] [--no-qa]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const step = (s) => console.log(`\n▶ ${s}`);
const sh = (cmd, a, opts = {}) => {
  const r = spawnSync(cmd, a, { stdio: "inherit", ...opts });
  if (r.status !== 0) { console.error(`✗ ${cmd} ${a.join(" ")} failed`); process.exit(r.status ?? 1); }
};

// 1 ── resolve ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
step("resolve story");
const dir = path.dirname(file);
const story = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(story.id)) { console.error(`story.id "${story.id}" must use only a-z, 0-9 and "-"`); process.exit(1); }
if (typeof story.words === "string") story.words = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, story.words), "utf8"));
if (!Array.isArray(story.words) || !story.words.length) { console.error("story.words is missing (run scripts/transcribe.mjs first)"); process.exit(1); }
if (!fs.existsSync(path.join("public", story.vo.file))) { console.error(`VO not found: public/${story.vo.file}`); process.exit(1); }
fs.mkdirSync("src/stories/data", { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(`src/stories/data/${story.id}.json`, JSON.stringify(story, null, 1));
const ids = fs.readdirSync("src/stories/data").filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json")).map((f) => f.replace(/\.json$/, "")).sort();
const camel = (s) => "s_" + s.replace(/-/g, "_");
fs.writeFileSync("src/stories/registry.ts", `// Generated by scripts/make.mjs — every story in src/stories/data becomes two compositions.\nimport type { Story } from "../kits/characterflow/director/story.ts";\n${ids.map((id) => `import ${camel(id)} from "./data/${id}.json";`).join("\n")}\n\nexport const STORIES: Story[] = [${ids.map((id) => `${camel(id)} as unknown as Story`).join(", ")}];\n`);
const rootFile = "src/Root.tsx", root = fs.readFileSync(rootFile, "utf8");
if (!root.includes("CharacterFlowFilms")) {
  const lastImport = [...root.matchAll(/^import .*;$/gm)].pop(), close = root.lastIndexOf("</>");
  if (!lastImport || close < 0) { console.error(`✗ add <CharacterFlowFilms /> (from "./kits/characterflow/Films.tsx") to ${rootFile} by hand`); process.exit(1); }
  const at = lastImport.index + lastImport[0].length;
  const withEl = root.slice(0, close) + "  <CharacterFlowFilms />\n  " + root.slice(close);
  fs.writeFileSync(rootFile, withEl.slice(0, at) + '\nimport { CharacterFlowFilms } from "./kits/characterflow/Films.tsx";' + withEl.slice(at));
  console.log(`  registered CHARACTER FLOW films in ${rootFile}`);
}
console.log(`  ${story.id}: ${story.words.length} words, ${story.scenes?.length ? `${story.scenes.length + 1} places (${[story.env, ...story.scenes.map((x) => x.env)].join(" → ")})` : `env ${story.env}`}, cast ${story.cast.map((c) => c.look).join(" + ")}, ${story.beats.length} beats`);

// 2 ── direct ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
step("direct (compile the story)");
const { compile } = await import(path.resolve("src/kits/characterflow/director/compile.ts"));
let P;
try { P = compile(story); } catch (e) { console.error(`✗ ${e.message}`); process.exit(1); }
console.log(`  duration ${P.duration}s · ${P.shots.length} shots · ${(P.scenes ?? [P]).reduce((n, x) => n + (x.P ?? x).thoughts.length, 0)} thought bubbles · ${P.sound.length} sound cues`);
for (const sc of P.scenes ?? []) console.log(`  place ${sc.t0.toFixed(2).padStart(6)}–${sc.t1.toFixed(2).padEnd(6)} ${sc.P.env.id} (${sc.P.time}) · ${sc.P.chars.map((c) => c.id).join(" + ")}`);
for (const s of P.shots) console.log(`  ${s.t0.toFixed(2).padStart(6)}–${Math.min(s.t1, P.duration).toFixed(2).padEnd(6)} ${s.kind.padEnd(10)} ${s.a}${s.b ? " → " + s.b : ""}`);
const outDir = path.join("out", story.id);
fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "shots.json"), JSON.stringify({ duration: P.duration, voOffset: P.cues.offset, shots: P.shots.map((s) => ({ kind: s.kind, a: s.a, b: s.b, t0: s.t0, t1: Math.min(s.t1, P.duration) })) }, null, 1));

// 3 ── sound ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
step("sound");
sh(process.execPath, ["--experimental-strip-types", "--no-warnings", "scripts/sound-story.ts", `src/stories/data/${story.id}.json`]);

// 4 ── render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const stills = opt("stills");
if (stills) {
  step("stills");
  // seconds past the end are dropped (with a note) instead of failing the render
  const all = stills.split(",").map((x) => parseFloat(x)).filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x));
  const ok = all.filter((x) => x >= 0 && x < P.duration - 0.05);
  if (ok.length < all.length) console.log(`  (skipped stills past the end of the ${P.duration}s film: ${all.filter((x) => !ok.includes(x)).join(", ")})`);
  if (!ok.length) { console.error("✗ no stills inside the film"); process.exit(1); }
  const secs = ok.map((x) => `${x}s`).join(",");
  sh("node", ["scripts/stills.mjs", path.join(outDir, "stills"), secs, `${story.id}-preview`]);
}
const preview = flag("preview"), final = flag("final") || (!preview && !stills);
let video = null;
if (preview) {
  step("render preview (540×960 @ 30, with audio)");
  video = path.join(outDir, `${story.id}_preview.mp4`);
  sh("npx", ["remotion", "render", `${story.id}-preview`, video, "--codec=h264", "--crf=20", `--concurrency=${opt("concurrency", "6")}`]);
}
if (final) {
  step("render final (1080×1920 @ 60, H.264 + AAC, −14 LUFS)");
  // finished segments survive an interrupted render while the story is unchanged: re-running resumes
  const seg = path.join(outDir, "seg"), stamp = path.join(seg, "story.json");
  const resolved = fs.readFileSync(`src/stories/data/${story.id}.json`, "utf8");
  if (!fs.existsSync(stamp) || fs.readFileSync(stamp, "utf8") !== resolved) fs.rmSync(seg, { recursive: true, force: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(seg, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(stamp, resolved);
  video = path.join(outDir, `${story.id}_1080x1920_60fps.mp4`);
  sh("node", ["scripts/render-final.mjs", `--comp=${story.id}-final`, `--out=${video}`, `--vo=public/audio/${story.id}-mix.wav`, "--offset=0", "--parts=4", `--concurrency=${opt("concurrency", "4")}`, `--seg=${seg}`]);
}

// 5 ── QA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (video && !flag("no-qa")) {
  step("QA");
  sh("node", ["scripts/qa.mjs", video, `--vo=public/${story.vo.file}`, `--offset=${P.cues.offset}`, `--expect=${P.duration}`, `--shots=${path.join(outDir, "shots.json")}`, ...(final ? ["--final"] : [])]);
  // visual review gate: the automated checks never see a hand through a face — someone has to look.
  // REVIEW.md stays "PENDING" until every row is filled; never call the video QA PASS before that.
  const pages = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(outDir, "qa", "qa.json"), "utf8")).contactPages ?? [];
  const rows = [
    "every shot shows the acting person's face (a head bowed over a phone is fine)",
    "the action reads (arm visible for point / wave / explain, body for sit / stand)",
    "props in frame when used (phone, bag)",
    "no camera inside / against furniture, trees, walls or bedding; nobody blocks the lens",
    "no limbs at odd angles; nobody inside furniture or another person; feet on the floor / seat",
    "thought bubbles fully in frame and readable",
    "captions inside the safe area, never over a face",
    "continuity across cuts and place changes (who is where, props, light)",
    "frame errors (black / white / frozen / flicker, burnt highlights)",
    "VO sync; actions land on their words",
    "faces readable on a phone (not too dark)",
    "pacing: no long stretch of one view; no flash cuts",
  ];
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "qa", "REVIEW.md"), [
    `# Visual review — ${story.id} (${path.basename(video)})`, "", "STATUS: PENDING VISUAL REVIEW", "",
    `Look at EVERY page of the 1-fps contact sheet — ${pages.map((p) => `${p.file} (${p.from}–${p.to} s)`).join(", ") || "contact_1fps_*.jpg"} — one tile per second, left→right then top→bottom; together they cover the whole video — and shots_start_mid_end.jpg (open the video for anything doubtful). Tick each page below.`, "",
    ...pages.map((p) => `- [ ] ${p.file} (${p.from}–${p.to} s) seen`), "",
    "Then fill every row with PASS / FIX + what you saw. Set STATUS to PASS only when no FIX is left.", "",
    "| check | verdict | notes |", "|---|---|---|", ...rows.map((r) => `| ${r} | | |`), "",
  ].join("\n"));
  console.log(`  review gate → ${path.join(outDir, "qa", "REVIEW.md")} (PENDING until a visual review is written)`);
}
console.log(`\n✓ done${video ? `: ${video}` : ""}`);

==== 12702 scripts/qa.mjs
// Automated QA of a rendered video. Writes out/<id>/qa/{qa.json, contact_1fps_001.jpg …, shots_start_mid_end.jpg}
// (the 1-fps contact sheet covers the whole video in pages of 96 seconds, each tile stamped with its second)
// and prints PASS/FAIL per check. The contact sheets are for the visual review that follows.
//   node scripts/qa.mjs <video.mp4> --vo=public/audio/x.mp3 --offset=0.4 --expect=49.8 [--shots=out/<id>/shots.json] [--final]
//                       [--size=1080x1920] [--from=12]   (--from: the video is a section starting at that film second)

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const video = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
const final = args.includes("--final");
if (!video || !fs.existsSync(video)) { console.error("usage: node scripts/qa.mjs <video.mp4> --vo=… --offset=… --expect=… [--shots=…] [--final]"); process.exit(1); }
const run = (c, a) => spawnSync(c, a, { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 1 << 30 });
const qaDir = path.join(path.dirname(video), "qa");
fs.mkdirSync(qaDir, { recursive: true });
const checks = [];
const check = (name, ok, detail) => { checks.push({ name, ok, detail }); console.log(`  ${ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL"}  ${name}: ${detail}`); };

// streams
const probe = JSON.parse(run("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_streams", "-show_format", "-of", "json", video]).stdout);
const v = probe.streams.find((s) => s.codec_type === "video"), a = probe.streams.find((s) => s.codec_type === "audio");
const dur = Number(probe.format.duration), expect = Number(opt("expect", dur));
const [fn, fd] = v.r_frame_rate.split("/").map(Number);
const fps = fn / fd;
const [sw, shh] = opt("size", "1080x1920").split("x").map(Number);
const portraitV = shh > sw;
// previews are half size; finals must be the exact delivery size at 60 fps
const sizeOk = final ? v.width === sw && v.height === shh && Math.abs(fps - 60) < 0.01 : Math.abs(v.width / v.height - sw / shh) < 0.01;
check("video stream", v.codec_name === "h264" && sizeOk, `${v.codec_name} ${v.width}×${v.height} @ ${fps} fps${final ? ` (final must be ${sw}×${shh} @ 60)` : ` (${portraitV ? "portrait" : "landscape"} aspect)`}`);
check("audio stream", !!a && a.codec_name === "aac", a ? `${a.codec_name} ${a.sample_rate} Hz, ${Number(a.duration ?? dur).toFixed(2)} s` : "missing");
check("duration", Math.abs(dur - expect) < 0.12, `${dur.toFixed(2)} s (expected ${expect.toFixed(2)} s)`);
if (a) check("audio length = video length", Math.abs(Number(a.duration ?? dur) - dur) < 0.15, `${Number(a.duration ?? dur).toFixed(2)} vs ${dur.toFixed(2)} s`);

// frame scan: white / black / sudden flashes
const ylog = path.join(qaDir, "yavg.txt");
run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", video, "-vf", `scale=192:108,signalstats,metadata=mode=print:file=${ylog}`, "-f", "null", "-"]);
const ytxt = fs.readFileSync(ylog, "utf8");
const y = (ytxt.match(/YAVG=[\d.]+/g) ?? []).map((s) => Number(s.slice(5)));
// 90th percentile luma per frame (video range: black is 16) — a frame whose p90 stays ≤ 24 is practically black
const y90 = (ytxt.match(/YHIGH=[\d.]+/g) ?? []).map((s) => Number(s.slice(6)));
// black: the opening fade, scene fades and the end card may be dark on purpose — only long runs fail
const white = y.filter((x) => x > 225).length;
// blown highlights: share of the picture burnt to white (a lamp in close-up, bloom) — the mean luma misses it
const hlog = path.join(qaDir, "hot.txt");
// the middle of the frame (a bright sky at the top is not a lamp in the lens); video range: white is 235
run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", video, "-vf", `crop=iw*0.7:ih*0.6:iw*0.15:ih*0.2,scale=160:120,lutyuv=y='if(gt(val,222),255,0)',signalstats,metadata=mode=print:key=lavfi.signalstats.YAVG:file=${hlog}`, "-f", "null", "-"]);
const hot = (fs.readFileSync(hlog, "utf8").match(/YAVG=[\d.]+/g) ?? []).map((s) => Number(s.slice(5)) / 255);
let hr = 0, hotLongest = 0, hotAt = -1;
hot.forEach((x, i) => { hr = x > 0.12 ? hr + 1 : 0; if (hr > hotLongest) { hotLongest = hr; hotAt = (i - hr + 1) / fps; } });
let run0 = 0, longest = 0;
y.slice(Math.round(fps * 0.9), y.length - Math.round(fps * 1.2)).forEach((x) => { run0 = x < 7 ? run0 + 1 : 0; longest = Math.max(longest, run0); });
const black = longest > fps * 0.7 ? longest : 0;
check("no white frames", white === 0, `${white} frames with mean luma > 225`);
check("no blown-out highlights", hotLongest < fps * 0.5, hotLongest ? `${(hotLongest / fps).toFixed(1)} s with > 12 % of the middle of the picture burnt white (from ${(hotAt + Number(opt("from", 0))).toFixed(1)} s) — a lamp / bloom too close` : "none");
check("no black gaps (outside fades)", black === 0, `longest near-black run ${(longest / fps).toFixed(2)} s (fails above 0.7 s)`);
// frozen picture (a stuck render shows as identical frames)
const fz = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-i", video, "-vf", "scale=320:180,freezedetect=n=0.0006:d=2.5", "-an", "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
const freezes = [...fz.matchAll(/freeze_start: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1])).filter((t) => t > 1 && t < dur - 6);
check("no frozen picture", freezes.length === 0, freezes.length ? `frozen from ${freezes.map((t) => t.toFixed(1)).join(", ")} s` : "none (≥ 2.5 s)");
// loudness (final delivery is mastered to −14 LUFS, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP)
if (a) {
  const lu = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-nostats", "-i", video, "-vn", "-af", "ebur128=peak=true", "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
  const I = Number((lu.match(/I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS/g) ?? []).pop()?.match(/-?[\d.]+/)?.[0]);
  const TP = Number((lu.match(/Peak:\s+(-?[\d.]+) dBFS/g) ?? []).pop()?.match(/-?[\d.]+/)?.[0]);
  check("loudness", !final || (Math.abs(I + 14) < 1.2 && TP <= -0.8), `${I.toFixed(1)} LUFS integrated, true peak ${TP.toFixed(1)} dBTP${final ? " (target −14 LUFS, ≤ −1 dBTP)" : ""}`);
}
const jumps = [];
for (let i = 1; i < y.length; i++) if (Math.abs(y[i] - y[i - 1]) > 45) jumps.push(+(i / fps).toFixed(2));
console.log(`  info  luma ${Math.min(...y).toFixed(0)}–${Math.max(...y).toFixed(0)}, big jumps (cuts) at ${jumps.join(", ") || "none"}`);

// VO sync: cross-correlate the film's audio with the VO around the expected offset
const voFile = opt("vo"), off0 = Number(opt("offset", 0)), section = opt("from") !== "";
// a section that starts after the VO has begun: compare with the VO from that point (expected lag 0)
const voSkip = Math.max(0, -off0), off = Math.max(0, off0);
if (voFile && fs.existsSync(voFile)) {
  const SR = 8000;
  const raw = (f, ss = 0) => { const r = spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", ...(ss ? ["-ss", ss.toFixed(3)] : []), "-i", f, "-f", "f32le", "-ac", "1", "-ar", String(SR), "-"], { maxBuffer: 1 << 30 }); return new Float32Array(r.stdout.buffer, r.stdout.byteOffset, Math.floor(r.stdout.length / 4)); };
  const film = raw(video), vo = raw(voFile, voSkip);
  let best = -1, lag = 0;
  for (let L = Math.round((off - 0.25) * SR); L <= Math.round((off + 0.25) * SR); L++) {
    if (L < 0) continue;
    let s = 0, e1 = 0, e2 = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < vo.length && i + L < film.length; i += 3) { const p = vo[i], q = film[i + L]; s += p * q; e1 += p * p; e2 += q * q; }
    const c = s / Math.sqrt(e1 * e2 + 1e-12);
    if (c > best) { best = c; lag = L; }
  }
  const err = lag / SR - off;
  check("VO sync", Math.abs(err) < 0.03 && best > 0.6, `VO found at ${(lag / SR).toFixed(3)} s (expected ${off.toFixed(3)}, error ${(err * 1000).toFixed(0)} ms, correlation ${best.toFixed(2)})`);
  const voEnd = off + vo.length / SR;
  if (!section) check("VO not cut", voEnd <= dur + 0.02, `VO ends at ${voEnd.toFixed(2)} s, video ${dur.toFixed(2)} s`);
}

// contact sheets (portrait: tall tiles): one tile per second for the WHOLE video, 96 per page
// (contact_1fps_001.jpg, _002.jpg …), every tile stamped with its film second so nothing can be skipped unseen
const tw = portraitV ? 180 : 320, thh = portraitV ? 320 : 180;
const grid = portraitV ? [12, 8] : [8, 12], perPage = grid[0] * grid[1];
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(qaDir)) if (/^contact_1fps(_\d+)?\.jpg$/.test(f)) fs.rmSync(path.join(qaDir, f));
// a second stamp on each tile when this ffmpeg has drawtext (not every build does); the page ranges are always listed
const hasDrawtext = /drawtext/.test(run("ffmpeg", ["-hide_banner", "-filters"]).stdout ?? "");
const fontFile = ["/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf", "/Library/Fonts/Arial.ttf", "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", "C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf"].find((f) => fs.existsSync(f));
const t0s = Number(opt("from", 0));
const stamp = hasDrawtext && fontFile ? `,drawtext=fontfile='${fontFile}':text='%{eif\\:t+${t0s}\\:d}s':x=6:y=6:fontsize=${portraitV ? 22 : 20}:fontcolor=yellow:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.6` : "";
const sheetArgs = (sync) => ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", video, "-vf", `fps=1,scale=${tw}:${thh}${stamp},tile=${grid[0]}x${grid[1]}`, ...sync, "-start_number", "1", path.join(qaDir, "contact_1fps_%03d.jpg")];
// one output image per full (or last, partial) page: -fps_mode on ffmpeg ≥ 5.1, -vsync on older builds
if (run("ffmpeg", sheetArgs(["-fps_mode", "passthrough"])).status !== 0) run("ffmpeg", sheetArgs(["-vsync", "0"]));
const pages = fs.readdirSync(qaDir).filter((f) => /^contact_1fps_\d+\.jpg$/.test(f)).sort();
const needPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.floor(dur) / perPage));
const pageRanges = pages.map((f, i) => ({ file: f, from: Math.round(t0s + i * perPage), to: Math.round(t0s + Math.min(dur, (i + 1) * perPage)) }));
check("contact sheet covers the whole video", pages.length >= needPages, `${pages.length} page(s) of ${perPage} s for ${dur.toFixed(1)} s: ${pageRanges.map((p) => `${p.file} ${p.from}–${p.to} s`).join(", ")}${stamp ? "" : " (tiles not stamped: this ffmpeg has no drawtext — tiles run left→right, top→bottom, one per second)"}`);
const shotsFile = opt("shots");
const from = Number(opt("from", 0));
if (shotsFile && fs.existsSync(shotsFile)) {
  const { shots: all } = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(shotsFile, "utf8"));
  // shots of this video (a section: only those inside it, in video time)
  const shots = all.map((s) => ({ ...s, t0: Math.max(0, s.t0 - from), t1: Math.min(dur, s.t1 - from) })).filter((s) => s.t1 - s.t0 > 0.2);
  // phone readability: the middle of every shot must not sink into black (night ≠ unreadable)
  const dark = shots.filter((s) => { const i = Math.round(((s.t0 + s.t1) / 2) * fps); return y[i] !== undefined && y[i] < 22 && !(s.t0 < 1); });
  // a shot that is practically black for its whole length shows nothing on a phone (darkness needs a sliver of light)
  const black = shots.filter((s) => { if (s.t1 - s.t0 < 1.4 || s.t0 < 1 || s.t1 > dur - 1) return false; const a = Math.round((s.t0 + 0.3) * fps), b = Math.round((s.t1 - 0.3) * fps); const seg = y.slice(a, b); return seg.length && Math.max(...y90.slice(a, b)) <= 24; });
  check("readable on a phone (not too dark)", dark.length <= Math.max(1, Math.floor(shots.length * 0.15)) && black.length === 0, `${dark.length}/${shots.length} shots with mid-frame mean luma < 22${dark.length ? ` (at ${dark.map((s) => (s.t0 + from).toFixed(1)).join(", ")} s)` : ""}${black.length ? ` · ${black.length} practically black shot(s) at ${black.map((s) => (s.t0 + from).toFixed(1)).join(", ")} s` : ""}`);
  const tmp = path.join(qaDir, "tmp");
  fs.mkdirSync(tmp, { recursive: true });
  let n = 0;
  for (const s of shots) for (const f of [0.12, 0.5, 0.88]) {
    const t = Math.min(dur - 0.05, s.t0 + (s.t1 - s.t0) * f);
    run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", t.toFixed(3), "-i", video, "-frames:v", "1", "-vf", `scale=${tw}:${thh}`, path.join(tmp, `f${String(n++).padStart(3, "0")}.png`)]);
  }
  const cols = portraitV ? 9 : 6;
  run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-pattern_type", "glob", "-i", path.join(tmp, "f*.png"), "-vf", `tile=${cols}x${Math.ceil(n / cols)}`, "-frames:v", "1", path.join(qaDir, "shots_start_mid_end.jpg")]);
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
  console.log(`  info  ${shots.length} shots sampled at start/middle/end → ${path.join(qaDir, "shots_start_mid_end.jpg")}`);
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(qaDir, "qa.json"), JSON.stringify({ video, duration: dur, fps, checks, cutsAt: jumps, contactSheets: pages, contactPages: pageRanges }, null, 1));
const failed = checks.filter((c) => !c.ok);
console.log(failed.length ? `\nQA: ${failed.length} check(s) FAILED — fix before delivering` : `\nQA: all ${checks.length} automated checks passed — now review ${qaDir}/*.jpg`);
process.exit(failed.length ? 3 : 0);

==== 11917 scripts/sound-story.ts
// Automatic sound department for any story: compiles the story exactly like the film, then places
// ambience (per environment and time of day), footsteps (from the walkers / turns), SFX per acting
// verb, music sections per mood, and mixes it all under the voice-over (ducked; music never covers it).
//   node scripts/sound-story.ts stories/<id>/story.json   → public/audio/<id>-mix.wav

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compile } from "../src/kits/characterflow/director/compile.ts";
import type { Story } from "../src/kits/characterflow/director/story.ts";
import {
  Bus, S, SR, bell, biquad, boing, breath, cheer, clap, click, dbg, decode, duckEnvelope, envExp, ep, freeverb, heartbeat, kalimba, pad, pink, pluck, pop,
  rng, rustle, shimmer, sine, smooth, sneakerStep, squeak, subPulse, thud, ticktock, whistle, whoosh, writeWav, zipper, type Out,
} from "./synth.ts";

const file = process.argv[2];
if (!file) { console.error("usage: node scripts/sound-story.ts stories/<id>/story.json"); process.exit(1); }
const story = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8")) as Story;
const P = compile(story);
const DUR = P.duration;
const N = Math.round(DUR * SR);
const amb = new Bus(N), music = new Bus(N), sfx = new Bus(N), verb = new Bus(N);
const M: Out = { dry: music, verb }, F: Out = { dry: sfx, verb };
const quiet = (t: number) => P.music.some((m) => m.mood === "awkward" && t >= m.t0 && t < m.t1);

// ── ambience (per place: a story with scenes changes the room tone at each cut) ──
const places = P.scenes ? P.scenes.map((x) => ({ t0: x.t0, t1: x.t1, env: x.P.env, time: x.P.time })) : [{ t0: 0, t1: DUR, env: P.env, time: P.time }];
const placeAt = (t: number) => places.find((x) => t >= x.t0 && t < x.t1) ?? places[places.length - 1];
/** a short fade at each cut so the room tones swap without a click */
const win = (t: number, a: number, b: number) => smooth(a - 0.06, a + 0.06, t) * (1 - smooth(b - 0.06, b + 0.06, t));
const chirps = (seed: number, t0: number, t1: number, gap: [number, number], f0: number, g: number, pan: number) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  for (let t = t0 + 0.5 + r() * 2; t < t1 - 0.2; t += gap[0] + r() * gap[1]) { const f = f0 + r() * 1200, d = 0.08, x = sine(d, (u) => f * (1 + 0.3 * Math.sin((u / d) * Math.PI))); for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / x.length); amb.add(t, biquad(x, "lp", 3000), g, pan); }
};
for (const pl of places) {
  const shape = (x: Float32Array, k: (t: number) => number) => { for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const t = i / SR; x[i] *= win(t, pl.t0, pl.t1) * k(t); } return x; };
  if (pl.env.ambience === "campus") {
    const air = biquad(pink(N, 4), "lp", 900), babble = biquad(biquad(pink(N, 12), "bp", 700, 0.6), "lp", 2200);
    shape(air, () => 0.55);
    shape(babble, (t) => (0.16 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 0.37)) * (quiet(t) ? 0.2 : 1));
    amb.add(0, air, 0.5, -0.1);
    amb.add(0, babble, 0.5, 0.15);
    for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) {
      const r = rng(500 + b);
      for (let t = pl.t0 + r() * 2; t < pl.t1; t += 1.2 + r() * 3.2) {
        if (quiet(t) && r() > 0.2) continue;
        const f = 2800 + b * 700 + r() * 600, pan = r() * 1.6 - 0.8;
        for (let c = 0, n = 1 + Math.floor(r() * 3); c < n; c++) {
          const d = 0.06 + r() * 0.08, x = sine(d, (u) => f * (1 + 0.35 * Math.sin((u / d) * Math.PI)));
          for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / x.length);
          amb.add(t + c * (d + 0.04), x, 0.018, pan);
        }
      }
    }
    continue;
  }
  // indoors: room tone, plus what each kind of room sounds like
  const room = shape(biquad(pink(N, 6), "lp", 180), () => 1);
  amb.add(0, room, 0.34, 0);
  if (pl.env.ambience === "cafe" || pl.env.ambience === "class") {
    const babble = shape(biquad(biquad(pink(N, 14), "bp", 650, 0.7), "lp", 2000), (t) => (pl.env.ambience === "cafe" ? 0.13 : 0.06) * (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 0.43)) * (quiet(t) ? 0.25 : 1));
    amb.add(0, babble, 0.5, 0.1);
  }
  if (pl.env.ambience === "cafe") {
    const r = rng(41);
    for (let t = pl.t0 + 0.8 + r() * 2; t < pl.t1 - 0.3; t += 1.6 + r() * 3.5) bell(F, t, r() < 0.5 ? "E7" : "C7", 0.012 + r() * 0.01, 0.4, r() * 1.4 - 0.7);
    for (let t = pl.t0 + 3 + r() * 4; t < pl.t1 - 2; t += 9 + r() * 7) whoosh(F, t, 1.6, 0.012, 2500, 3200, 0.5, 0.5);
  } else if (pl.env.ambience === "office") {
    const hum = shape(biquad(pink(N, 8), "bp", 120, 0.5), () => 0.5);
    amb.add(0, hum, 0.3, 0);
    const r = rng(43);
    for (let t = pl.t0 + 1 + r() * 2; t < pl.t1 - 1; t += 3 + r() * 4) for (let k = 0, n = 4 + Math.floor(r() * 8); k < n; k++) click(F, t + k * (0.09 + r() * 0.07), 3200 + r() * 800, 0.012, 0.6, 0.004);
  }
  if (pl.time === "night" && pl.env.id === "bedroom") {
    const r = rng(100);
    for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) { const f = 4200 + r() * 800, pan = 0.2 + r() * 0.6; for (let t = pl.t0 + r(); t < pl.t1; t += 0.6 + r() * 0.5) for (let p = 0; p < 3; p++) { const x = sine(0.03, f); for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / x.length); amb.add(t + p * 0.044, biquad(x, "lp", 2600), 0.014, pan); } }
  } else if (pl.time !== "night" && (pl.env.ambience === "room" || pl.env.ambience === "class")) chirps(7, pl.t0, pl.t1, [2.5, 4], 3200, 0.012, 0.6);
}
{
  // crickets when the story says "awkward silence"
  for (const m of P.music) if (m.mood === "awkward") {
    const r = rng(77);
    for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) for (let t = m.t0 + 0.2 + c * 0.11; t < m.t1 - 0.2; t += 0.55 + r() * 0.15) for (let p = 0; p < 3; p++) { const x = sine(0.03, 4300 + c * 400); for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / x.length); amb.add(t + p * 0.045, x, 0.05, c - 1); }
  }
}

// ── SFX per cue ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let k = 0;
for (const c of P.sound) {
  const pan = c.pan ?? 0, t = c.t;
  switch (c.kind) {
    case "step": sneakerStep(F, t, placeAt(t).env.indoor ? (placeAt(t).env.home ? 0.05 : 0.065) : 0.085, pan, k++); break;
    case "ding": bell(F, t, k++ % 2 ? "G6" : "E6", 0.3, 1.4, pan); break;
    case "boing": boing(F, t, 0.1, 160, 480, 0.6, pan); break;
    case "whoosh": whoosh(F, t, 0.32, 0.045, 700, 2600, pan - 0.2, pan + 0.2); break;
    case "pocket": whoosh(F, t, 0.25, 0.03, 1800, 600, pan, pan); break;
    case "zip": zipper(F, t, 0.35, 0.05, pan); for (let tt = t + 0.4; tt < t + 3; tt += 0.55) rustle(F, tt, 0.35, 0.022, pan, 2600); break;
    case "pop": pop(F, t, 0.05, 660, pan); break;
    case "popHi": pop(F, t, 0.055, 1047, pan); break;
    case "popThought": pop(F, t, 0.06, 784 + 100 * (k++ % 3), pan); break;
    case "squeak": squeak(F, t, 0.04, pan); break;
    case "slap": thud(F, t, 0.06, 160, 0.04, pan); break;
    case "clap": clap(F, t, 0.26, 0); break;
    case "sparkle": shimmer(F, t, 1.0, 0.6, 3000, k++); break;
    case "click": click(F, t, 2600, 0.14, -0.4, 0.01); thud(F, t + 0.005, 0.05, 140, 0.05, -0.4); break;
    case "rustle": rustle(F, t, 1.0, 0.06, pan, 1900); break;
    case "breath": breath(F, t, 1.1, 1.5, 0.045); break;
    case "heartbeat": for (let tt = t, iv = 0.9; tt < t + 4; tt += iv, iv = Math.max(0.55, iv * 0.93)) heartbeat(F, tt, 0.18); break;
    case "tick": ticktock(F, t, t + 1.4, 0.045); break;
    case "board": boing(F, t, 0.12, 140, 480, 0.7, -0.2); whistle(F, t + 0.35, 0.55, 0.05, 0.1); cheer(F, t + 0.45, 1.6, 0.06); break;
    case "tumbleweed": whoosh(F, t - 0.3, 3.2, 0.05, 260, 700, 0.7, -0.7); break;
  }
}

// ── music per mood section ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const beat = 60 / 108;
const pizz = (t: number, n: string, g: number, pan = 0) => pluck(M, t, n, g, pan, 0.985, 0.35);
for (const m of P.music) {
  const t0 = m.t0 + 0.05, t1 = m.t1;
  if (t1 - t0 < 0.8) continue;
  if (m.mood === "playful") {
    const prog = [["F2", "A3", "C4", "F4"], ["E2", "G3", "C4", "E4"], ["D2", "F3", "A3", "D4"], ["Bb1", "F3", "Bb3", "D4"]];
    const tune = ["C5", "A4", "F4", "A4", "G4", "E4", "C4", "E4"];
    for (let i = 0, t = t0; t < t1 - 0.1; i++, t = t0 + i * beat) {
      const ch = prog[Math.floor(i / 4) % 4];
      pizz(t, ch[0], 0.065, -0.1);
      if (i % 2) ch.slice(1).forEach((n, j) => pizz(t + j * 0.012, n, 0.022, j - 1));
      if (i % 4 === 0) kalimba(M, t + beat * 0.5, tune[(i / 4) % tune.length], 0.18, 0.2);
    }
  } else if (m.mood === "warm") {
    const prog = [["C3", "G3", "C4", "E4"], ["A2", "E3", "C4", "E4"], ["F2", "C3", "A3", "E4"], ["G2", "D3", "B3", "D4"]];
    for (let i = 0, t = t0; t < t1 - 0.3; i++, t = t0 + i * 1.6) { ep(M, t, prog[i % 4], 0.42, 2.2); if (i % 2 === 0) kalimba(M, t + 0.8, ["E5", "G5", "C6", "A5"][i % 4], 0.22, 0.2); }
    pad(M, t0, t1 + 0.6, ["C3", "G3", "E4"], 0.14, 1000, 0.6, 1.0);
  } else if (m.mood === "calm") {
    pad(M, t0, t1 + 0.8, ["F2", "C3", "A3", "E4"], 0.2, 800, 1.2, 1.4);
    for (let t = t0 + 0.8; t < t1 - 0.5; t += 3.2) bell(M, t, ["A5", "E5", "C6"][Math.floor(t) % 3], 0.08, 2.5, 0.2);
  } else if (m.mood === "sad") {
    pad(M, t0, t1 + 0.8, ["D2", "A2", "F3", "C4"], 0.2, 650, 0.8, 1.2);
    for (let t = t0 + 0.4, j = 0; t < t1 - 0.5; t += 1.4, j++) ep(M, t, [["D4"], ["C4"], ["A3"], ["Bb3"]][j % 4], 0.35, 1.6);
  } else if (m.mood === "tense") {
    pad(M, t0, t1, ["A1", "E2", "Bb2"], 0.22, 420, 0.6, 0.3);
    for (let t = t0; t < t1 - 0.2; t += beat / 2) pizz(t, ["A3", "E4", "C4", "E4"][Math.round((t - t0) / (beat / 2)) % 4], 0.035, 0.3);
    subPulse(M, t0, 0.18);
  }
  // "awkward": no music — only the crickets
}
void envExp; void S;

// ── mix ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const vL = freeverb(verb.L, 0, 0.78, 0.35), vR = freeverb(verb.R, 23, 0.78, 0.35);
for (const b of [music, amb, sfx]) { biquad(b.L, "hp", 38); biquad(b.R, "hp", 38); }
const voFile = path.join("public", story.vo.file);
const voSrc = decode(voFile);
const off = P.cues.offset;
const vo = new Float32Array(N);
vo.set(voSrc.subarray(0, Math.max(0, N - Math.round(off * SR))), Math.round(off * SR));
const duck = duckEnvelope(vo);
const MUSIC_DUCK = dbg(-10), AMB_DUCK = dbg(-5), SFX_DUCK = dbg(-3);
const gMusic = dbg(-2), gAmb = dbg(-1), gSfx = dbg(0), gVerb = dbg(-8);
const L = new Float32Array(N), R = new Float32Array(N);
let eV = 0, eB = 0, nS = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
  const d = duck[i];
  const km = gMusic * (1 + (MUSIC_DUCK - 1) * d), ka = gAmb * (1 + (AMB_DUCK - 1) * d), ks = gSfx * (1 + (SFX_DUCK - 1) * d), kv = gVerb * (1 + (MUSIC_DUCK - 1) * d * 0.6);
  const bl = music.L[i] * km + amb.L[i] * ka + sfx.L[i] * ks + vL[i] * kv, br = music.R[i] * km + amb.R[i] * ka + sfx.R[i] * ks + vR[i] * kv;
  const f = smooth(0, 0.25, i / SR) * (1 - smooth(DUR - 0.9, DUR - 0.02, i / SR));
  L[i] = (bl + vo[i]) * f;
  R[i] = (br + vo[i]) * f;
  if (d > 0.9 && i % 64 === 0) { eV += vo[i] ** 2; eB += (bl * bl + br * br) / 2; nS++; }
}
let peak = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(L[i]), Math.abs(R[i]));
const norm = peak > dbg(-1) ? dbg(-1) / peak : 1;
const out = path.join("public", "audio", `${story.id}-mix.wav`);
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
writeWav(out, L, R, norm);
console.log(`mix: ${out} (${DUR}s; VO ${(voSrc.length / SR).toFixed(2)} s at ${off}s → ends ${(off + voSrc.length / SR).toFixed(2)} s)`);
console.log(`bed under speech: ${nS ? (10 * Math.log10(eB / nS) - 10 * Math.log10(eV / nS)).toFixed(1) : "n/a"} dB relative to the voice; ${P.sound.length} cues; music: ${P.music.map((m) => `${m.mood}@${m.t0.toFixed(1)}`).join(", ")}`);

==== 20103 scripts/synth.ts
// CHARACTERFLOW sound kit: a tiny deterministic synthesiser (no samples, no third-party audio).
// Buses, filters, oscillators, instruments, foley generators, reverb and a VO-ducking mixer.
// Topic scores (scripts/sound.ts) place these on the film clock.

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";

export const SR = 48000;
export const S = (t: number) => Math.round(t * SR);

export const rng = (seed: number) => () => {
  seed |= 0;
  seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
  let x = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
  x = (x + Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 7), 61 | x)) ^ x;
  return ((x ^ (x >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
};
export const clamp = (x: number, a: number, b: number) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, x));
export const smooth = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => { const k = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return k * k * (3 - 2 * k); };
export const dbg = (db: number) => 10 ** (db / 20);
const mtof = (m: number) => 440 * 2 ** ((m - 69) / 12);
const NOTE: Record<string, number> = { C: 0, "C#": 1, Db: 1, D: 2, "D#": 3, Eb: 3, E: 4, F: 5, "F#": 6, Gb: 6, G: 7, "G#": 8, Ab: 8, A: 9, "A#": 10, Bb: 10, B: 11 };
export const nf = (n: string) => { const m = /^([A-G][#b]?)(-?\d)$/.exec(n)!; return mtof(12 * (Number(m[2]) + 1) + NOTE[m[1]]); };

export class Bus {
  L: Float32Array; R: Float32Array; N: number;
  constructor(N: number) { this.N = N; this.L = new Float32Array(N); this.R = new Float32Array(N); }
  /** add a mono signal at time t (s), equal-power pan −1..1 */
  add(t: number, x: Float32Array, gain = 1, pan = 0) {
    const o = S(t);
    const gl = Math.cos(((pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4) * gain * Math.SQRT2, gr = Math.sin(((pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4) * gain * Math.SQRT2;
    for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { const j = o + i; if (j < 0 || j >= this.N) continue; this.L[j] += x[i] * gl; this.R[j] += x[i] * gr; }
  }
  addSt(t: number, l: Float32Array, r: Float32Array, gain = 1) {
    const o = S(t);
    for (let i = 0; i < l.length; i++) { const j = o + i; if (j < 0 || j >= this.N) continue; this.L[j] += l[i] * gain; this.R[j] += r[i] * gain; }
  }
}

/** RBJ biquad, in place. `f` may vary per sample. */
export const biquad = (x: Float32Array, type: "lp" | "hp" | "bp" | "peak", f: number | ((i: number) => number), q = 0.707, gainDb = 0) => {
  let x1 = 0, x2 = 0, y1 = 0, y2 = 0, b0 = 0, b1 = 0, b2 = 0, a1 = 0, a2 = 0, lastF = -1;
  const coef = (fc: number) => {
    const w = (2 * Math.PI * clamp(fc, 10, SR * 0.45)) / SR, cw = Math.cos(w), sw = Math.sin(w), al = sw / (2 * q);
    let a0: number;
    if (type === "lp") { b0 = (1 - cw) / 2; b1 = 1 - cw; b2 = b0; a0 = 1 + al; a1 = -2 * cw; a2 = 1 - al; }
    else if (type === "hp") { b0 = (1 + cw) / 2; b1 = -(1 + cw); b2 = b0; a0 = 1 + al; a1 = -2 * cw; a2 = 1 - al; }
    else if (type === "bp") { b0 = al; b1 = 0; b2 = -al; a0 = 1 + al; a1 = -2 * cw; a2 = 1 - al; }
    else { const A = 10 ** (gainDb / 40); b0 = 1 + al * A; b1 = -2 * cw; b2 = 1 - al * A; a0 = 1 + al / A; a1 = -2 * cw; a2 = 1 - al / A; }
    b0 /= a0; b1 /= a0; b2 /= a0; a1 /= a0; a2 /= a0;
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
    const fc = typeof f === "number" ? f : f(i);
    if (typeof f !== "number" ? (i & 31) === 0 : lastF < 0) { coef(fc); lastF = fc; }
    const y = b0 * x[i] + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 - a1 * y1 - a2 * y2;
    x2 = x1; x1 = x[i]; y2 = y1; y1 = y;
    x[i] = y;
  }
  return x;
};

export const noise = (n: number, seed = 1) => { const r = rng(seed); const a = new Float32Array(n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = r() * 2 - 1; return a; };
export const pink = (n: number, seed = 1) => {
  const w = noise(n, seed); let b0 = 0, b1 = 0, b2 = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { b0 = 0.99765 * b0 + w[i] * 0.099046; b1 = 0.963 * b1 + w[i] * 0.2965164; b2 = 0.57 * b2 + w[i] * 1.0526913; w[i] = (b0 + b1 + b2 + w[i] * 0.1848) * 0.2; }
  return w;
};
export const envExp = (x: Float32Array, tau: number, attack = 0.002) => { for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { const t = i / SR; x[i] *= Math.min(1, t / attack) * Math.exp(-t / tau); } return x; };
export const envAR = (x: Float32Array, a: number, r: number) => { const d = x.length / SR; for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { const t = i / SR; x[i] *= smooth(0, a, t) * (1 - smooth(d - r, d, t)); } return x; };
export const sine = (dur: number, f: number | ((t: number) => number), phase = 0) => {
  const n = S(dur), a = new Float32Array(n); let p = phase;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const fr = typeof f === "number" ? f : f(i / SR); p += (2 * Math.PI * fr) / SR; a[i] = Math.sin(p); }
  return a;
};
export const saw = (dur: number, f: number, seed = 0) => {
  const n = S(dur), a = new Float32Array(n); let p = rng(seed)();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { p += f / SR; p -= Math.floor(p); a[i] = 2 * p - 1; }
  return a;
};
export const mixInto = (dst: Float32Array, src: Float32Array, g = 1) => { for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(dst.length, src.length); i++) dst[i] += src[i] * g; return dst; };

// ── instruments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type Out = { dry: Bus; verb: Bus };

/** Warm pad: 3 detuned saws per note → 2-pole low-pass, slow envelope. */
export const pad = (o: Out, t0: number, t1: number, notes: string[], g: number, cutoff = 900, a = 1.5, r = 1.5, pan = 0, bright = 0) => {
  const dur = t1 - t0, n = S(dur);
  const L = new Float32Array(n), R = new Float32Array(n);
  notes.forEach((nn, k) => {
    const f = nf(nn);
    for (const [d, p] of [[-0.006, -0.6], [0, 0], [0.007, 0.6]] as const) {
      const s = saw(dur, f * (1 + d), k * 7 + Math.round(d * 1000));
      const gl = Math.cos(((p * 0.7 + pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4), gr = Math.sin(((p * 0.7 + pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { L[i] += s[i] * gl; R[i] += s[i] * gr; }
    }
  });
  const fc = (i: number) => cutoff * (1 + bright * smooth(0, n, i));
  biquad(L, "lp", fc, 0.6); biquad(L, "lp", fc, 0.6); biquad(R, "lp", fc, 0.6); biquad(R, "lp", fc, 0.6);
  envAR(L, a, r); envAR(R, a, r);
  const k = g / Math.max(1, notes.length * 1.2);
  o.dry.addSt(t0, L, R, k);
  o.verb.addSt(t0, L, R, k * 0.5);
};

export const pluck = (o: Out, t: number, note: string, g: number, pan = 0, decay = 0.996, brightness = 0.5) => {
  const f = nf(note), p = Math.max(2, Math.round(SR / f));
  const n = S(2.2), y = new Float32Array(n), buf = noise(p, Math.round(t * 1000 + f));
  biquad(buf, "lp", 1500 + brightness * 5000);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = i % p; const v = buf[j]; buf[j] = decay * 0.5 * (v + buf[(j + 1) % p]); y[i] = v; }
  envExp(y, 0.9, 0.002);
  o.dry.add(t, y, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, y, g * 0.5, pan);
};

export const bell = (o: Out, t: number, note: string, g: number, dur = 3, pan = 0) => {
  const f = nf(note), n = S(dur), y = new Float32Array(n);
  for (const [m, a, tau] of [[1, 1, 1.4], [2.76, 0.45, 0.7], [5.4, 0.25, 0.35], [8.93, 0.12, 0.2]] as const) mixInto(y, envExp(sine(dur, f * m), tau * (dur / 3), 0.002), a);
  o.dry.add(t, y, g * 0.3, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, y, g * 0.35, pan);
};

export const kalimba = (o: Out, t: number, note: string, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const f = nf(note), y = envExp(sine(1.8, f), 0.55, 0.002);
  mixInto(y, envExp(sine(1.8, f * 5.4), 0.06, 0.001), 0.25);
  mixInto(y, envExp(sine(1.8, f * 2), 0.25, 0.002), 0.15);
  o.dry.add(t, y, g * 0.35, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, y, g * 0.3, pan);
};

/** Electric-piano chord (sine partials + tremolo). */
export const ep = (o: Out, t: number, notes: string[], g: number, dur: number) => {
  notes.forEach((nn, k) => {
    const f = nf(nn), y = envExp(sine(dur, f), dur * 0.45, 0.01);
    mixInto(y, envExp(sine(dur, f * 2), dur * 0.18, 0.005), 0.25);
    mixInto(y, envExp(sine(dur, f * 3), dur * 0.08, 0.003), 0.08);
    for (let i = 0; i < y.length; i++) y[i] *= 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin((2 * Math.PI * 4.5 * i) / SR);
    envAR(y, 0.01, 0.4);
    o.dry.add(t + k * 0.014, y, (g * 0.3) / notes.length, (k / Math.max(1, notes.length - 1) - 0.5) * 0.5);
    o.verb.add(t, y, (g * 0.25) / notes.length);
  });
};

export const subPulse = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, f0 = 55) => { const x = envExp(sine(0.6, (u) => f0 - 18 * Math.min(1, u * 5)), 0.12, 0.004); o.dry.add(t, x, g); };

// ── foley / design ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const click = (o: Out, t: number, f: number, g: number, pan = 0, tau = 0.012) => {
  const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.08), Math.round(t * 997)), "bp", f, 2.5), tau * 0.5, 0.0005);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.08, f * 0.62), tau, 0.0005), 0.4);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.15, pan);
};
export const thud = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, f = 60, tau = 0.18, pan = 0) => {
  const x = envExp(sine(0.8, (u) => f * (1.25 - 0.3 * Math.min(1, u * 4))), tau, 0.002);
  mixInto(x, envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.8), Math.round(t * 31)), "lp", 500), tau * 0.4, 0.002), 0.6);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.3, pan);
};
/** Fabric: band-passed noise with a slow, uneven swell. */
export const rustle = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, pan = 0, f = 2400) => {
  const n = S(dur);
  const x = biquad(biquad(noise(n, Math.round(t * 113)), "bp", f, 0.7), "hp", 700);
  const r = rng(Math.round(t * 71));
  let e = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const u = i / n;
    if ((i & 255) === 0) e = 0.55 + 0.45 * r();
    x[i] *= Math.sin(Math.PI * u) * e;
  }
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.12, pan);
};
export const whoosh = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, f0: number, f1: number, pan0 = -0.4, pan1 = 0.4) => {
  const n = S(dur);
  const x = biquad(noise(n, Math.round(t * 71)), "bp", (i) => f0 * (f1 / f0) ** (i / n), 1.2);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const u = i / n; x[i] *= Math.sin(Math.PI * u) ** 1.5; }
  const L = new Float32Array(n), R = new Float32Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = pan0 + (pan1 - pan0) * (i / n); L[i] = x[i] * Math.cos(((p + 1) * Math.PI) / 4); R[i] = x[i] * Math.sin(((p + 1) * Math.PI) / 4); }
  o.dry.addSt(t, L, R, g);
  o.verb.addSt(t, L, R, g * 0.3);
};
export const heartbeat = (o: Out, t: number, g: number) => {
  for (const [dt, k] of [[0, 1], [0.17, 0.7]] as const) {
    const x = envExp(sine(0.4, (u) => 58 - 22 * Math.min(1, u * 6)), 0.07, 0.004);
    biquad(x, "lp", 160);
    o.dry.add(t + dt, x, g * k);
  }
};
/** A soft notification "bloop": a rising sine blip with a bell sparkle. */
export const pop = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, f = 880, pan = 0) => {
  const x = envExp(sine(0.35, (u) => f * (0.75 + 0.35 * Math.min(1, u * 18))), 0.07, 0.003);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.35, f * 2.01), 0.04, 0.002), 0.25);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.35, f * 3.02), 0.02, 0.001), 0.12);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.35, pan);
};
export const shimmer = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, base = 2400, seed = 1) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  for (let k = 0; k < Math.round(dur * 26); k++) {
    const tt = t + r() * dur, f = base * (1 + r() * 2);
    const x = envExp(sine(0.25, f), 0.05 + r() * 0.08, 0.002);
    const w = Math.sin(Math.PI * ((tt - t) / dur));
    o.dry.add(tt, x, g * 0.05 * w, r() * 1.6 - 0.8);
    o.verb.add(tt, x, g * 0.05 * w, 0);
  }
};
/** Breath: filtered noise, inhale (rising) then exhale (falling). */
export const breath = (o: Out, t: number, inhale: number, exhale: number, g: number) => {
  const a = biquad(biquad(pink(S(inhale), Math.round(t * 17)), "bp", (i) => 900 + 700 * (i / S(inhale)), 0.8), "hp", 300);
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) a[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / a.length) ** 1.2;
  const b = biquad(biquad(pink(S(exhale), Math.round(t * 19)), "bp", (i) => 1300 - 700 * (i / S(exhale)), 0.7), "hp", 250);
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) b[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / b.length) ** 0.8;
  o.dry.add(t, a, g * 0.9);
  o.dry.add(t + inhale, b, g);
};
/** Pen on paper: short scratchy grains, one per stroke. */
export const scribble = (o: Out, t0: number, t1: number, g: number, seed = 5) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  let t = t0;
  while (t < t1) {
    const d = 0.05 + r() * 0.1;
    const x = biquad(biquad(noise(S(d), Math.round(t * 1000)), "bp", 3500 + r() * 2500, 1.4), "hp", 1800);
    for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / x.length) * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(i * 0.004 * (1 + r())));
    o.dry.add(t, x, g * (0.6 + 0.4 * r()), 0.15);
    t += d + r() * 0.05;
  }
};

/** Freeverb-style stereo reverb. */
export const freeverb = (x: Float32Array, spread: number, room = 0.84, damp = 0.25) => {
  const k = SR / 44100;
  const combs = [1116, 1188, 1277, 1356, 1422, 1491, 1557, 1617].map((d) => ({ b: new Float32Array(Math.round((d + spread) * k)), i: 0, f: 0 }));
  const aps = [556, 441, 341, 225].map((d) => ({ b: new Float32Array(Math.round((d + spread) * k)), i: 0 }));
  const y = new Float32Array(x.length);
  for (let n = 0; n < x.length; n++) {
    const inp = x[n] * 0.015;
    let out = 0;
    for (const c of combs) { const o = c.b[c.i]; c.f = o * (1 - damp) + c.f * damp; c.b[c.i] = inp + c.f * room; c.i = (c.i + 1) % c.b.length; out += o; }
    for (const a of aps) { const o = a.b[a.i]; a.b[a.i] = out + o * 0.5; a.i = (a.i + 1) % a.b.length; out = o - out; }
    y[n] = out;
  }
  return y;
};

/** Decode an audio file to mono float at SR. */
export const decode = (file: string) => {
  const raw = spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", file, "-f", "f32le", "-ac", "1", "-ar", String(SR), "-"], { maxBuffer: 1 << 30 }).stdout as Buffer;
  return new Float32Array(raw.buffer, raw.byteOffset, Math.floor(raw.length / 4));
};

/** Speech envelope → ducking gain 0…1 (attack 60 ms, release 380 ms). */
export const duckEnvelope = (vo: Float32Array) => {
  const N = vo.length, win = S(0.02), duck = new Float32Array(N);
  let env = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i += win) {
    let e = 0;
    for (let j = i; j < Math.min(N, i + win); j++) e += vo[j] * vo[j];
    const on = Math.sqrt(e / win) > 0.012 ? 1 : 0;
    const a = on > env ? 1 - Math.exp(-0.02 / 0.06) : 1 - Math.exp(-0.02 / 0.38);
    env += (on - env) * a;
    for (let j = i; j < Math.min(N, i + win); j++) duck[j] = env;
  }
  return duck;
};

export const writeWav = (file: string, l: Float32Array, r: Float32Array, k = 1) => {
  const N = l.length;
  const b = Buffer.alloc(44 + N * 4);
  b.write("RIFF", 0); b.writeUInt32LE(36 + N * 4, 4); b.write("WAVE", 8); b.write("fmt ", 12);
  b.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); b.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); b.writeUInt16LE(2, 22); b.writeUInt32LE(SR, 24); b.writeUInt32LE(SR * 4, 28);
  b.writeUInt16LE(4, 32); b.writeUInt16LE(16, 34); b.write("data", 36); b.writeUInt32LE(N * 4, 40);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    b.writeInt16LE(Math.round(clamp(l[i] * k, -1, 1) * 32767), 44 + i * 4);
    b.writeInt16LE(Math.round(clamp(r[i] * k, -1, 1) * 32767), 46 + i * 4);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(file, b);
};

// ── comedy kit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
/** Cartoon boing: a sine that springs up in pitch with a wobble. */
export const boing = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, f0 = 180, f1 = 520, dur = 0.6, pan = 0) => {
  const x = sine(dur, (u) => (f0 + (f1 - f0) * Math.min(1, u / (dur * 0.35))) * (1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(u * 2 * Math.PI * 14) * Math.exp(-u * 4)));
  envAR(x, 0.005, dur * 0.5);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(dur, f1 * 2), 0.08, 0.002), 0.15);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.3, pan);
};
/** Referee whistle: a pea-trill around 2.6 kHz. */
export const whistle = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const n = S(dur), x = new Float32Array(n);
  let p = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const u = i / SR;
    const f = 2650 + 180 * Math.sign(Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 28 * u));
    p += (2 * Math.PI * f) / SR;
    x[i] = Math.sin(p) * (0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 28 * u));
  }
  mixInto(x, biquad(noise(n, Math.round(t * 99)), "bp", 2650, 3), 0.25);
  envAR(x, 0.01, 0.05);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.25, pan);
};
/** Crowd cheer: band-limited noise swell with "voices" (formant wobble). */
export const cheer = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number) => {
  const n = S(dur);
  const x = biquad(biquad(pink(n, 55), "bp", (i) => 900 + 400 * Math.sin(i / SR * 9), 0.8), "hp", 250);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const u = i / n; x[i] *= Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, u * 1.6)) * (1 - u) * 1.4 * (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(i / SR * 37)); }
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, 0);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.4, 0);
};
/** Rubber squeak (an aborted gesture). */
export const squeak = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const x = sine(0.16, (u) => 1400 + 900 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 6));
  envAR(x, 0.01, 0.06);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
};
/** Zipper: a fast train of clicks. */
export const zipper = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const r = rng(Math.round(t * 77));
  for (let tt = 0; tt < dur; tt += 0.008 + r() * 0.006) {
    const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.02), Math.round((t + tt) * 3000)), "bp", 3500 + r() * 2500, 2), 0.003, 0.0005);
    o.dry.add(t + tt, x, g * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin((Math.PI * tt) / dur)), pan);
  }
};
/** Clock tick-tock. */
export const ticktock = (o: Out, t0: number, t1: number, g: number) => {
  let k = 0;
  for (let t = t0; t < t1; t += 0.5, k++) {
    const f = k % 2 ? 2300 : 3100;
    const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.05), k + 9), "bp", f, 6), 0.006, 0.0005);
    mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.05, f * 0.5), 0.01, 0.0005), 0.3);
    o.dry.add(t, x, g, k % 2 ? 0.25 : -0.25);
  }
};
/** Sad trombone: four falling notes, the last one wobbling. */
export const sadTrombone = (o: Out, t: number, g: number) => {
  const notes: [number, number][] = [[nf("D4"), 0.42], [nf("C#4"), 0.42], [nf("C4"), 0.42], [nf("B3"), 1.4]];
  let tt = t;
  notes.forEach(([f, d], k) => {
    const n = S(d), x = new Float32Array(n);
    let p = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const u = i / SR;
      const vib = k === 3 ? 1 + 0.03 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 6 * u) * Math.min(1, u * 2) : 1;
      p += (2 * Math.PI * f * vib * (1 - 0.01 * Math.exp(-u * 20))) / SR;
      const ph = (p / (2 * Math.PI)) % 1;
      x[i] = 2 * ph - 1;
    }
    biquad(x, "lp", 1400, 1.5);
    biquad(x, "peak", 600, 1, 6);
    envAR(x, 0.03, k === 3 ? 0.5 : 0.06);
    o.dry.add(tt, x, g * 0.35, 0.1);
    o.verb.add(tt, x, g * 0.2, 0.1);
    tt += d;
  });
};
/** Tape rewind: a high, warbling whirr that speeds up. */
export const rewindTape = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number) => {
  const n = S(dur), x = new Float32Array(n);
  let p = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const u = i / n;
    const f = 600 + 2400 * u * u + 300 * Math.sin(i / SR * 2 * Math.PI * 11);
    p += (2 * Math.PI * f) / SR;
    x[i] = Math.sin(p) * 0.4 + Math.sin(p * 1.5) * 0.2;
  }
  mixInto(x, biquad(noise(n, 31), "bp", (i) => 1500 + 3000 * (i / n), 1), 0.5);
  envAR(x, 0.05, 0.12);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, 0);
};
/** Hand clap / high five: sharp noise burst with a body thump. */
export const clap = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.25), Math.round(t * 333)), "bp", 1800, 0.9), 0.035, 0.0008);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.25, 190), 0.03, 0.001), 0.4);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.4, pan);
};
/** Sneaker step on pavers. */
export const sneakerStep = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, pan = 0, seed = 1) => {
  const r = rng(Math.round(t * 1000) + seed);
  const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.12), Math.round(t * 1000) + seed), "bp", 1100 + 500 * r(), 1.2), 0.018, 0.001);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.12, 85 + 20 * r()), 0.03, 0.002), 0.5);
  mixInto(x, envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.12), seed + 7), "hp", 5000), 0.006, 0.003), 0.15);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
};

==== 6401 scripts/transcribe.mjs
// Word timings for a voice-over → JSON [[word, start, end], …] (VO seconds).
//   node scripts/transcribe.mjs <vo.mp3> --out=stories/<id>/words.json [--script=script.txt] [--lang=id]
//   node scripts/transcribe.mjs <any/path/vo.mp3> --id=<id> [--script=…]   copies the VO to public/audio/<id>.<ext>
//                                                                          and writes stories/<id>/words.json
//
// 1. whisper.cpp when available (WHISPER_CLI + WHISPER_MODEL, or `whisper-cli` on PATH with a model in
//    ~/.cache/whisper.cpp or ./models) — real word timings.
// 2. otherwise, with the script text: the VO's speech segments (silence detection) are matched to the
//    script's sentences and words are spread by length inside each segment — close enough for beats
//    and captions, not exact per word.
// Without whisper and without a script there is nothing to align: the script text must be provided.

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const file = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
const id = opt("id");
if (id && !/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(id)) { console.error(`--id "${id}" must use only a-z, 0-9 and "-"`); process.exit(1); }
const out = opt("out") || (id ? `stories/${id}/words.json` : "");
if (file && fs.existsSync(file) && id) {
  const dst = path.join("public", "audio", `${id}${path.extname(file).toLowerCase() || ".mp3"}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst), { recursive: true });
  if (path.resolve(dst) !== path.resolve(file)) fs.copyFileSync(file, dst);
  console.log(`vo: ${dst}  →  story.json "vo": { "file": "${path.relative("public", dst)}", "offset": 0.4 }`);
}
if (!file || !fs.existsSync(file) || !out) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/transcribe.mjs <vo.mp3> (--id=<id> | --out=stories/<id>/words.json) [--script=script.txt] [--lang=id]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const run = (cmd, a) => spawnSync(cmd, a, { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 1 << 28 });
const duration = Number(run("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", file]).stdout.trim());

const findWhisper = () => {
  const home = os.homedir();
  const cands = [process.env.WHISPER_CLI, run("sh", ["-c", "command -v whisper-cli"]).stdout.trim(), "/opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli", "/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli"].filter(Boolean);
  const cli = cands.find((c) => fs.existsSync(c));
  const modelDirs = [path.join(home, ".cache/whisper.cpp"), path.resolve("models"), "/opt/homebrew/share/whisper-cpp"];
  let model = process.env.WHISPER_MODEL && fs.existsSync(process.env.WHISPER_MODEL) ? process.env.WHISPER_MODEL : null;
  if (!model) for (const d of modelDirs) { if (!fs.existsSync(d)) continue; const m = fs.readdirSync(d).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".bin")).sort((a, b) => (b.includes("large") ? 1 : 0) - (a.includes("large") ? 1 : 0))[0]; if (m) { model = path.join(d, m); break; } }
  return cli && model ? { cli, model } : null;
};

let words = null, method = "";
const W = findWhisper();
if (W) {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "cf-vo-"));
  const wav = path.join(tmp, "vo16k.wav");
  run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", file, "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1", wav]);
  run(W.cli, ["-m", W.model, "-f", wav, "-l", opt("lang", "id"), "-ml", "1", "-sow", "-ojf", "-of", path.join(tmp, "w")]);
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, "w.json"), "utf8"));
    words = j.transcription.map((s) => [s.text.trim(), s.offsets.from / 1000, s.offsets.to / 1000]).filter((w) => w[0]);
    method = `whisper.cpp (${path.basename(W.model)})`;
  } catch { words = null; }
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

if (!words) {
  const scriptFile = opt("script");
  if (!scriptFile || !fs.existsSync(scriptFile)) {
    console.error("No whisper.cpp found and no --script given. Provide the narration text (e.g. --script=stories/<id>/script.txt) or install whisper.cpp (see the skill's references/setup.md).");
    process.exit(2);
  }
  const text = fs.readFileSync(scriptFile, "utf8").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  // speech segments from silence detection
  const log = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-i", file, "-af", "silencedetect=n=-38dB:d=0.18", "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
  const st = [...log.matchAll(/silence_start: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
  const en = [...log.matchAll(/silence_end: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
  const segs = [];
  let cur = 0;
  st.forEach((s, i) => { if (s - cur > 0.12) segs.push([cur, s]); cur = en[i] ?? duration; });
  if (duration - cur > 0.12) segs.push([cur, duration]);
  const toks = text.split(" ").filter(Boolean);
  // sentences / clauses = groups ending in punctuation; map groups to segments by cumulative length
  const total = toks.reduce((s, w) => s + w.length + 1, 0);
  const speech = segs.reduce((s, [a, b]) => s + (b - a), 0);
  // speech-time position for a fraction of the text, then into real time through the segments
  const toTime = (frac) => {
    let need = frac * speech;
    for (const [a, b] of segs) { if (need <= b - a) return a + need; need -= b - a; }
    return segs.length ? segs[segs.length - 1][1] : duration;
  };
  // snap clause ends to the nearest segment end when one is close
  let acc = 0;
  words = toks.map((w) => {
    const a = acc / total;
    acc += w.length + 1;
    const b = (acc - 1) / total;
    let t0 = toTime(a), t1 = toTime(b);
    if (/[.,?!;:]$/.test(w)) { const near = segs.map((s) => s[1]).reduce((best, e) => (Math.abs(e - t1) < Math.abs(best - t1) ? e : best), t1); if (Math.abs(near - t1) < 0.6) t1 = near; }
    return [w, +t0.toFixed(2), +Math.max(t0 + 0.08, t1).toFixed(2)];
  });
  // keep times monotonic
  for (let i = 1; i < words.length; i++) if (words[i][1] < words[i - 1][2]) words[i][1] = words[i - 1][2];
  method = `script aligned to ${segs.length} speech segments (approximate word timing)`;
}

fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify(words.map(([w, a, b]) => [w, +a.toFixed(2), +b.toFixed(2)])));
console.log(`words: ${out} — ${words.length} words, ${duration.toFixed(2)} s, via ${method}`);
console.log(words.map(([w, a]) => `${a.toFixed(2)} ${w}`).join("  "));

==== 2032 scripts/tts.mjs
// Offline narration with the operating system's voice (only with the user's approval — it is a
// stand-in for a real voice-over). macOS: `say` (Indonesian voice "Damayanti"). Writes an MP3 and,
// because the text is known, the word timings too.
//   node scripts/tts.mjs <script.txt> <public/audio/<id>.mp3> --words=stories/<id>/words.json [--voice=Damayanti] [--rate=170]

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";

const [scriptFile, outMp3] = process.argv.slice(2).filter((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (process.argv.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
if (!scriptFile || !outMp3) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/tts.mjs <script.txt> <out.mp3> --words=stories/<id>/words.json [--voice=Damayanti] [--rate=170]");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (process.platform !== "darwin") {
  console.error("Built-in TTS is only wired for macOS (`say`). On other systems record or generate the voice-over elsewhere and use scripts/transcribe.mjs.");
  process.exit(2);
}
const voice = opt("voice", "Damayanti"), rate = opt("rate", "170");
const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "cf-tts-"));
const aiff = path.join(tmp, "vo.aiff");
const r = spawnSync("say", ["-v", voice, "-r", rate, "-o", aiff, "-f", scriptFile], { encoding: "utf8" });
if (r.status !== 0) { console.error(r.stderr || `say failed (voice "${voice}" installed?)`); process.exit(3); }
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outMp3), { recursive: true });
spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", aiff, "-af", "apad=pad_dur=0.2", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "1", "-b:a", "160k", outMp3]);
fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
console.log(`tts: ${outMp3} (${voice}, rate ${rate})`);
const words = opt("words");
if (words) {
  const t = spawnSync("node", [path.join("scripts", "transcribe.mjs"), outMp3, `--out=${words}`, `--script=${scriptFile}`], { stdio: "inherit" });
  process.exit(t.status ?? 0);
}

==== 13109 src/kits/characterflow/camera/shots.ts
// Shot library for 9:16 character storytelling (Node-safe maths). Every preset frames "subjects"
// (face position + facing) for a portrait frame — the narrow horizontal field means two people are
// framed side-on or down a line, never as a wide landscape two-shot. `safeCam` keeps any camera
// inside the environment and out of its keep-out zones.

import { Vector3 } from "three";
import type { Cam } from "../render/FilmPost.tsx";
import type { V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";
import type { EnvData } from "../env/registry.ts";

export type Subject = { face: V3; fwd: V3; pos: V3 };
export type ShotKind =
  | "establish" | "wide" | "closeUp" | "medium" | "mediumWide" | "twoShot" | "ots" | "track" | "pathDown"
  | "reaction" | "explain" | "think" | "sitStand" | "turn" | "boardWide" | "bedWide" | "bedClose" | "bedThink";
export type ShotSpec = { kind: ShotKind; a: string; b?: string; side?: 1 | -1; t0: number; t1: number; /** wide two-person: camera direction from the pair (chosen by the director to fit the set) */ dir?: V3 };

const V = (v: V3) => new Vector3(...v);
const A = (v: Vector3): V3 => [v.x, v.y, v.z];
const flat = (v: V3) => { const x = V(v).setY(0); return x.lengthSq() < 1e-6 ? new Vector3(0, 0, 1) : x.normalize(); };
const drift = (t: number, amt: number): V3 => [amt * 0.012 * (Math.sin(t * 0.83) + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 2.1 + 1)), amt * 0.008 * Math.sin(t * 1.07 + 2), amt * 0.01 * Math.sin(t * 0.61 + 4)];
const add = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]];
/** distance that frames `h` metres of height with vertical fov `fov` (deg) */
const distFor = (h: number, fov: number) => h / 2 / Math.tan((fov * Math.PI) / 360);
/** a direction rotated `deg` around +Y */
const rotY = (v: Vector3, deg: number) => v.clone().applyAxisAngle(new Vector3(0, 1, 0), (deg * Math.PI) / 180);
const ease = (x: number) => { const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x)); return k * k * (3 - 2 * k); };

/** in front of a subject at an angle (deg, + = toward his left), framing height h */
const front = (s: Subject, angle: number, h: number, fov: number, up = 0, lookUp = 0): { pos: V3; target: V3 } => {
  const d = distFor(h, fov);
  const dir = rotY(flat(s.fwd), angle);
  const p = V(s.face).addScaledVector(dir, d).add(new Vector3(0, up, 0));
  return { pos: A(p), target: [s.face[0], s.face[1] + lookUp, s.face[2]] };
};

/** Horizontal half-width of the 9:16 frame per metre of distance at a vertical fov of 42°. */
const HALF_W = Math.tan((42 * Math.PI) / 360) * (9 / 16);
/** Distance that fits two people (positions a, b) side by side when seen from direction dir. */
export const pairDist = (a: V3, b: V3, dir: V3) => {
  const right = new Vector3(-dir[2], 0, dir[0]).normalize();
  const w = Math.abs(V(b).sub(V(a)).dot(right)) / 2 + 0.45;
  return Math.max(distFor(3.0, 42), w / HALF_W);
};
/**
 * The best direction for a wide shot of two people inside a set: both inside the frame, the camera
 * inside the room, as many faces toward the lens as possible. null when no direction fits.
 */
export const pairDir = (a: Subject, b: Subject, inside: (p: V3) => boolean): V3 | null => {
  const mid = V(a.pos).add(V(b.pos)).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  let best: V3 | null = null, bestS = -Infinity;
  for (let deg = 0; deg < 360; deg += 10) {
    const dir: V3 = [Math.sin((deg * Math.PI) / 180), 0, Math.cos((deg * Math.PI) / 180)];
    const d = pairDist(a.pos, b.pos, dir);
    const p: V3 = [mid.x + dir[0] * d, 1.7, mid.z + dir[2] * d];
    if (!inside(p)) continue;
    const face = (s: Subject) => Math.max(-0.5, flat(s.fwd).dot(V(dir)));
    const score = face(a) + face(b) - 0.08 * d;
    if (score > bestS) { bestS = score; best = dir; }
  }
  // two people in profile (facing each other) score about 0; both turned away score below −0.5
  return best && bestS > -0.45 ? best : null;
};

export const SHOTS: Record<ShotKind, (S: Record<string, Subject>, spec: ShotSpec, t: number) => Cam> = {
  establish: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a], k = ease((t - sp.t0) / Math.max(0.5, sp.t1 - sp.t0));
    const dir = rotY(flat(s.fwd), 55 * (sp.side ?? 1));
    const hi = V(s.pos).addScaledVector(dir, 9).add(new Vector3(0, 6, 0));
    const lo = V(s.pos).addScaledVector(dir, 6.2).add(new Vector3(0, 2.0, 0));
    return { pos: add(A(hi.lerp(lo, k)), drift(t, 0.4)), target: [s.pos[0], 1.2 + 0.3 * k, s.pos[2]], fov: 44, aperture: 0.0006, maxBlur: 0.003 };
  },
  wide: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a];
    if (sp.b && S[sp.b] && sp.dir) {
      const o = S[sp.b], mid = V(s.pos).add(V(o.pos)).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      const d = pairDist(s.pos, o.pos, sp.dir);
      const p = mid.clone().addScaledVector(V(sp.dir), d).add(new Vector3(0, 1.7, 0));
      return { pos: add(A(p), drift(t, 0.4)), target: [mid.x, 0.95, mid.z], fov: 42, aperture: 0.0006, maxBlur: 0.003 };
    }
    const f = front(s, 35 * (sp.side ?? 1), 3.4, 42, 0.6);
    return { pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.4)), target: [s.pos[0], 1.0, s.pos[2]], fov: 42, aperture: 0.0006, maxBlur: 0.003 };
  },
  closeUp: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a];
    const f = front(s, 25 * (sp.side ?? 1), 0.55, 28, 0.03);
    return { ...f, pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.25)), fov: 28, aperture: 0.002, maxBlur: 0.006 };
  },
  medium: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a];
    const f = front(s, 30 * (sp.side ?? 1), 1.05, 36, 0.0, -0.18);
    return { ...f, pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.4)), fov: 36, aperture: 0.0014, maxBlur: 0.005 };
  },
  mediumWide: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a];
    const f = front(s, 32 * (sp.side ?? 1), 2.1, 40, -0.25, -0.55);
    return { ...f, pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.4)), fov: 40, aperture: 0.001, maxBlur: 0.004 };
  },
  // two people: camera perpendicular to the line between them, far enough for both + margin
  twoShot: (S, sp, t) => {
    const a = V(S[sp.a].face), b = V(S[sp.b ?? sp.a].face);
    const mid = a.clone().add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
    const line = b.clone().sub(a).setY(0);
    const sep = Math.max(0.6, line.length());
    let perp = new Vector3(-line.z, 0, line.x).normalize();
    if (perp.z < 0) perp.negate();
    if (sp.side === -1) perp.negate();
    const fov = 42, halfW = Math.tan(Math.atan(Math.tan((fov * Math.PI) / 360) * (9 / 16)));
    const d = Math.max(distFor(1.4, fov), (sep / 2 + 0.55) / halfW);
    const p = mid.clone().addScaledVector(perp, d).add(new Vector3(0, -0.1, 0));
    return { pos: add(A(p), drift(t, 0.3)), target: [mid.x, mid.y - 0.22, mid.z], fov, aperture: 0.0009, maxBlur: 0.004 };
  },
  // over the shoulder of `a`, looking at `b`
  ots: (S, sp, t) => {
    const a = S[sp.a], b = S[sp.b ?? sp.a];
    const ab = V(b.face).sub(V(a.face)).setY(0).normalize();
    const side = new Vector3(-ab.z, 0, ab.x).multiplyScalar(sp.side ?? 1);
    const p = V(a.face).addScaledVector(ab, -0.95).addScaledVector(side, 0.45).add(new Vector3(0, 0.12, 0));
    const dist = V(b.face).distanceTo(p);
    const fov = Math.max(18, Math.min(34, 34 - (dist - 2) * 1.2));
    return { pos: add(A(p), drift(t, 0.4)), target: [b.face[0], b.face[1] - 0.22, b.face[2]], fov, aperture: 0.0012, maxBlur: 0.005 };
  },
  track: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a];
    const f = front(s, 22 * (sp.side ?? 1), 1.5, 36, -0.05, -0.3);
    return { ...f, pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.6)), fov: 36, aperture: 0.0014, maxBlur: 0.005 };
  },
  // down the walk line from behind `a` toward `b` (encounters at distance)
  pathDown: (S, sp, t) => {
    const a = S[sp.a], b = S[sp.b ?? sp.a];
    const ab = V(b.pos).sub(V(a.pos)).setY(0).normalize();
    const side = new Vector3(-ab.z, 0, ab.x).multiplyScalar(sp.side ?? 1);
    const p = V(a.pos).addScaledVector(ab, -2.3).addScaledVector(side, 1.6).add(new Vector3(0, 2.0, 0));
    const tg = V(a.pos).lerp(V(b.pos), 0.45).add(new Vector3(0, 1.35, 0));
    return { pos: add(A(p), drift(t, 0.4)), target: A(tg), fov: 42, aperture: 0.0008, maxBlur: 0.004 };
  },
  reaction: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a], k = ease((t - sp.t0) / Math.max(0.5, sp.t1 - sp.t0));
    const f = front(s, 18 * (sp.side ?? 1), 0.62 - 0.12 * k, 28, 0.02);
    return { ...f, pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.25)), fov: 28, aperture: 0.002, maxBlur: 0.006 };
  },
  explain: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a];
    const f = front(s, 38 * (sp.side ?? 1), 1.2, 38, 0.02, -0.2);
    return { ...f, pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.4)), fov: 38, aperture: 0.0012, maxBlur: 0.005 };
  },
  // headroom above for a thought bubble
  think: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a];
    const f = front(s, 28 * (sp.side ?? 1), 1.75, 40, 0.15, 0.22);
    return { ...f, pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.4)), fov: 40, aperture: 0.0012, maxBlur: 0.004 };
  },
  // the subject in the lower frame with room behind/above for a sign or gag beside the path
  boardWide: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a], b = S[sp.b ?? sp.a];
    const mx = (s.pos[0] + b.pos[0]) / 2, mz = (s.pos[2] + b.pos[2]) / 2;
    const span = Math.hypot(s.pos[0] - b.pos[0], s.pos[2] - b.pos[2]);
    const d = Math.max(6.2, span / 2 / 0.24 + 1.5);
    return { pos: add([mx, 1.9, mz + d], drift(t, 0.4)), target: [mx, 2.0, mz - 0.4], fov: 46, aperture: 0.0006, maxBlur: 0.003 };
  },
  // someone lying / sitting up in bed: fixed high angles from the foot side of the bed (the head's
  // facing is useless while lying, and the camera must not swing while they sit up or lie down)
  bedWide: (S, sp, t) => {
    const f = S[sp.a].face;
    return { pos: add([f[0] + 0.4, f[1] + 1.3, f[2] + 1.85], drift(t, 0.3)), target: [f[0], f[1] - 0.12, f[2] + 0.45], fov: 38, aperture: 0.0008, maxBlur: 0.004 };
  },
  bedClose: (S, sp, t) => {
    const f = S[sp.a].face;
    return { pos: add([f[0] + 0.35, f[1] + 0.95, f[2] + 1.05], drift(t, 0.2)), target: [f[0], f[1] - 0.05, f[2] + 0.08], fov: 34, aperture: 0.0014, maxBlur: 0.005 };
  },
  // lying with a thought bubble: lower, from the side of the bed, headroom above the face
  bedThink: (S, sp, t) => {
    const f = S[sp.a].face;
    return { pos: add([f[0] + 1.05, f[1] + 0.5, f[2] + 1.25], drift(t, 0.3)), target: [f[0] - 0.08, f[1] + 0.32, f[2] - 0.08], fov: 42, aperture: 0.001, maxBlur: 0.004 };
  },
  sitStand: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a];
    const f = front(s, 40 * (sp.side ?? 1), 2.0, 40, -0.35, -0.55);
    return { ...f, pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.3)), fov: 40, aperture: 0.0009, maxBlur: 0.004 };
  },
  turn: (S, sp, t) => {
    const s = S[sp.a], k = ease((t - sp.t0) / Math.max(0.5, sp.t1 - sp.t0));
    const f = front(s, (55 - 25 * k) * (sp.side ?? 1), 1.7, 38, -0.1, -0.35);
    return { ...f, pos: add(f.pos, drift(t, 0.3)), fov: 38, aperture: 0.001, maxBlur: 0.004 };
  },
};

/** Shots that frame one person (another person must not stand between the lens and them). */
export const SOLO_SHOTS: ShotKind[] = ["closeUp", "medium", "mediumWide", "explain", "think", "reaction", "sitStand", "turn", "track"];

/** The camera moved around `pivot` (a vertical axis) by `deg`; it keeps looking at the same target. */
export const orbitCam = (c: Cam, pivot: V3, deg: number): Cam => {
  if (!deg) return c;
  const off = V(c.pos).sub(V(pivot));
  return { ...c, pos: A(V(pivot).add(rotY(off, deg))) };
};

/** True when someone else's head or chest is within `clear` m of the line from the lens to the subject's face. */
export const peopleBlock = (c: Cam, me: Subject, others: Subject[], clear = 0.3) => {
  const p = V(c.pos), f = V(me.face), d = f.clone().sub(p);
  const len = d.length();
  d.normalize();
  return others.some((o) => [V(o.face), V(o.face).add(new Vector3(0, -0.35, 0))].some((q) => {
    const s = q.clone().sub(p).dot(d);
    if (s < 0 || s > len - 0.25) return false;
    return p.clone().addScaledVector(d, s).distanceTo(q) < clear;
  }));
};

/** True when this camera sits on the set's open side (where cameras belong). */
export const onViewSide = (c: Cam, env: EnvData) => V(c.pos).sub(V(c.target)).setY(0).dot(V(env.viewSide)) >= -0.05;

/**
 * Keep a camera inside the environment, outside its keep-out spheres, and with nothing between the
 * lens and the subject: anything in the way makes the camera slide along the view line past it.
 */
export const safeCam = (c: Cam, env: EnvData): Cam => {
  const p = V(c.pos), tg = V(c.target);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    let moved = false;
    for (const b of env.blockers) {
      const C = V(b.c), dir = tg.clone().sub(p);
      const len = dir.length();
      dir.normalize();
      const s = Math.min(len, Math.max(0, C.clone().sub(p).dot(dir)));
      const closest = p.clone().addScaledVector(dir, s);
      if (closest.distanceTo(C) < b.r && s < len - 0.6) {
        // past the far side of the sphere along the view line (never closer than 0.6 m to the subject)
        const half = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, b.r * b.r - closest.distanceToSquared(C)));
        p.addScaledVector(dir, Math.min(len - 0.6, s + half + 0.12));
        moved = true;
      }
    }
    if (!moved) break;
  }
  const { min, max } = env.bounds;
  p.set(Math.min(max[0], Math.max(min[0], p.x)), Math.min(max[1], Math.max(min[1], p.y)), Math.min(max[2], Math.max(min[2], p.z)));
  return { ...c, pos: A(p) };
};

==== 4499 src/kits/characterflow/captions/Captions.tsx
// Word-timed captions for 9:16. Chunks of ≤ 4 words, karaoke-style progression, highlighted phrases,
// and a placement per chunk (top or bottom band) chosen by the scene so captions never cover the face.
// Laid out at 1080 × 1920 overlay pixels.

import React from "react";
import { ease, remap } from "../../../core/motion/easing.ts";
import { FONT } from "../../../core/type/fonts.ts";
import type { Word } from "../timing/cues.ts";

export type CapWord = { text: string; t0: number; t1: number; hi: boolean };
export type Chunk = { words: CapWord[]; t0: number; t1: number };

const norm = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, "");

/** Split a transcript into caption chunks; `highlights` are phrases (any number of words). */
export const chunkWords = (words: Word[], offset: number, highlights: string[], maxWords = 4, maxChars = 24): Chunk[] => {
  const hiSet = new Set<number>();
  const keys = words.map((w) => norm(w[0]));
  for (const h of highlights) {
    const hw = h.split(/\s+/).map(norm);
    for (let i = 0; i + hw.length <= keys.length; i++) if (hw.every((x, k) => keys[i + k] === x)) for (let k = 0; k < hw.length; k++) hiSet.add(i + k);
  }
  const out: Chunk[] = [];
  let cur: CapWord[] = [];
  const flush = () => {
    if (!cur.length) return;
    out.push({ words: cur, t0: cur[0].t0, t1: cur[cur.length - 1].t1 });
    cur = [];
  };
  words.forEach(([text, a, b], i) => {
    const len = cur.reduce((s, w) => s + w.text.length + 1, 0) + text.length;
    // keep highlighted phrases together
    const inPhrase = hiSet.has(i) && i > 0 && hiSet.has(i - 1);
    if (cur.length && !inPhrase && (cur.length >= maxWords || len > maxChars)) flush();
    cur.push({ text, t0: offset + a, t1: offset + b, hi: hiSet.has(i) });
    if (/[.?!,]$/.test(text) && !(hiSet.has(i) && hiSet.has(i + 1))) flush();
  });
  flush();
  // merge single-word orphans into the previous chunk when it is short
  const merged: Chunk[] = [];
  for (const c of out) {
    const prev = merged[merged.length - 1];
    if (prev && c.words.length === 1 && prev.words.length < 4 && c.t0 - prev.t1 < 0.3 && !/[.?!]$/.test(prev.words[prev.words.length - 1].text)) {
      prev.words.push(...c.words);
      prev.t1 = c.t1;
    } else merged.push({ ...c, words: [...c.words] });
  }
  return merged;
};

export type Zone = "top" | "mid" | "bottom";
/** top edge of each caption band (px in the 1080×1920 frame) */
export const ZONE_TOP: Record<Zone, number> = { top: 250, mid: 860, bottom: 1350 };

export const Captions: React.FC<{ chunks: Chunk[]; t: number; zone: (c: Chunk) => Zone; accent?: string }> = ({ chunks, t, zone, accent = "#ffd25e" }) => {
  const idx = chunks.findIndex((c, i) => t >= c.t0 - 0.1 && t < (chunks[i + 1]?.t0 ?? c.t1 + 0.6) - 0.02 && t < c.t1 + 0.6);
  if (idx < 0) return null;
  const c = chunks[idx];
  const inK = ease.out(remap(t, c.t0 - 0.1, c.t0 + 0.12));
  const next = chunks[idx + 1];
  const outK = 1 - ease.in(remap(t, Math.min(c.t1 + 0.45, (next?.t0 ?? 999) - 0.12), Math.min(c.t1 + 0.6, (next?.t0 ?? 999) - 0.02)));
  const a = inK * outK;
  const z = zone(c);
  const top = ZONE_TOP[z];
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 70, right: 70, top, display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", opacity: a, transform: `translateY(${(1 - inK) * 18}px) scale(${0.96 + 0.04 * inK})` }}>
