      <div style={{ fontFamily: FONT, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 64, lineHeight: 1.18, textAlign: "center", letterSpacing: "-0.01em", maxWidth: 900, padding: "14px 30px 18px", borderRadius: 28, background: "rgba(8,12,28,0.38)", boxShadow: "0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)", backdropFilter: "blur(6px)" }}>
        {c.words.map((w, i) => {
          const said = t >= w.t0 - 0.03;
          const cur = said && t < w.t1 + 0.05;
          const pop = w.hi ? 1 + 0.05 * ease.out(remap(t, w.t0 - 0.03, w.t0 + 0.12)) * (1 - ease.inOut(remap(t, w.t1, w.t1 + 0.35))) : 1;
          return (
            <React.Fragment key={i}>
            <span style={{ display: "inline-block", transform: `scale(${pop})`, margin: w.hi ? "0 0.06em" : undefined, color: w.hi && said ? accent : "#ffffff", opacity: said ? 1 : 0.42, textShadow: w.hi && said ? `0 0 26px ${accent}88, 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)` : "0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)", fontWeight: w.hi ? 600 : cur ? 600 : 500 }}>
              {w.text}
            </span>
            {i < c.words.length - 1 ? " " : ""}
            </React.Fragment>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

==== 2510 src/kits/characterflow/captions/Cards.tsx
// Full-frame 2D cards for storytelling beats: a cartoon "time skip" title card and a VHS-style rewind
// overlay. Laid out at 1080 × 1920; text comes from the topic.

import React from "react";
import { ease, remap } from "../../../core/motion/easing.ts";
import { FONT } from "../../../core/type/fonts.ts";

/** Bouncy title card over the shot (e.g. "5 DETIK KEMUDIAN…"). */
export const TitleCard: React.FC<{ t: number; t0: number; t1: number; text: string; sub?: string; top?: number }> = ({ t, t0, t1, text, sub, top = 300 }) => {
  if (t < t0 || t > t1) return null;
  const inK = ease.out(remap(t, t0, t0 + 0.3));
  const outK = 1 - ease.in(remap(t, t1 - 0.25, t1));
  const pop = 0.7 + 0.3 * inK + 0.06 * Math.sin(Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 0.5) * Math.PI);
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, top, display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", opacity: outK }}>
      <div style={{ transform: `scale(${pop}) rotate(${-3 + 1.5 * Math.sin(t * 2)}deg)`, background: "#ffd166", color: "#1d2a4d", fontFamily: FONT, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 78, letterSpacing: "0.02em", padding: "22px 46px 26px", borderRadius: 30, border: "8px solid #1d2a4d", boxShadow: "0 14px 0 #1d2a4d, 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)", textAlign: "center" }}>
        {text}
        {sub ? <div style={{ fontSize: 38, fontWeight: 500, marginTop: 6 }}>{sub}</div> : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/** VHS rewind: scan lines, a rolling bar, ◀◀ icon. */
export const RewindOverlay: React.FC<{ t: number; t0: number; t1: number; label?: string }> = ({ t, t0, t1, label }) => {
  if (t < t0 || t > t1) return null;
  const a = ease.out(remap(t, t0, t0 + 0.12)) * (1 - ease.in(remap(t, t1 - 0.15, t1)));
  const bar = ((t - t0) * 1.7) % 1;
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, opacity: a, pointerEvents: "none" }}>
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, background: "repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.18) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.18) 3px, transparent 3px, transparent 7px)" }} />
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, top: `${bar * 100}%`, height: 90, background: "linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.22), transparent)" }} />
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 70, top: 120, fontFamily: FONT, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 96, color: "#ffffff", textShadow: "4px 4px 0 #ff4fa3, -4px -2px 0 #4fd8ff", opacity: Math.floor(t * 4) % 2 ? 1 : 0.65 }}>
        ◀◀ {label ?? ""}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

==== 11130 src/kits/characterflow/character/Character.tsx
// The CHARACTERFLOW character: one procedural rig, any spec (spec.ts), any pose (pose.ts). Every joint
// group takes its matrix from skeleton.ts, so props, cameras and IK agree with what is drawn.
// Built from lathe/sphere primitives with fabric/skin/hair materials — appealing stylised proportions
// (large head, big eyes, soft hands) with clean silhouettes that read on a phone screen.

import React from "react";
import { CapsuleGeometry, Euler, Matrix4, Quaternion, Vector3 } from "three";
import { box, cached, cyl, lathe, sphere, torus } from "../lib/geo.ts";
import { Head } from "./Head.tsx";
import { charMats, type CharMats, type Variant } from "./materials.ts";
import type { Hand, Pose } from "./pose.ts";
import { skeleton, type Skeleton } from "./skeleton.ts";
import { DIMS, type CharacterSpec } from "./spec.ts";

const _p = new Vector3(), _q = new Quaternion(), _s = new Vector3();
/** A joint group placed by a local matrix. */
const J: React.FC<{ m: Matrix4; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ m, children }) => {
  m.decompose(_p, _q, _s);
  return <group position={[_p.x, _p.y, _p.z]} quaternion={[_q.x, _q.y, _q.z, _q.w]} scale={[_s.x, _s.y, _s.z]}>{children}</group>;
};

/** Tapered limb along −Y from 0 to −len with round caps. */
export const limb = (len: number, r0: number, r1: number, mid = 0) =>
  cached(`cflimb${len},${r0},${r1},${mid}`, () => {
    const pts: [number, number][] = [];
    const n = 8;
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * (Math.PI / 2);
      pts.push([Math.sin(a) * r1, -len - Math.cos(a) * r1]);
    }
    for (let i = 1; i < 10; i++) {
      const k = i / 10;
      pts.push([r1 + (r0 - r1) * k + Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * mid, -len + len * k]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * (Math.PI / 2);
      pts.push([Math.cos(a) * r0, Math.sin(a) * r0]);
    }
    return lathe(`cflimbL${len},${r0},${r1},${mid}`, pts, 28);
  });

// loose tee: soft shoulders, slight flare and a rolled hem
const TORSO: [number, number][] = [
  [0.0, -0.375], [0.19, -0.37], [0.205, -0.35], [0.198, -0.3], [0.188, -0.2], [0.192, -0.08], [0.207, 0.05], [0.222, 0.15],
  [0.218, 0.205], [0.19, 0.243], [0.14, 0.268], [0.085, 0.281], [0.0, 0.285],
];
const PELVIS: [number, number][] = [[0, -0.135], [0.118, -0.128], [0.16, -0.08], [0.168, 0.0], [0.166, 0.09], [0.0, 0.105]];
const capsule = (r: number, l: number) => cached(`cfcap${r},${l}`, () => new CapsuleGeometry(r, l, 6, 14));

const HandMesh: React.FC<{ s: number; h: Hand; m: CharMats; t: number; tremble: number; cs: boolean }> = ({ s, h, m, t, tremble, cs }) => {
  const fingers = [0.025, 0.0085, -0.0085, -0.024];
  const lens = [1, 1.08, 1.02, 0.84];
  const tr = tremble * 0.08;
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={box(0.032, 0.088, 0.076, 0.015)} material={m.skin} position={[0, -0.05, 0.002]} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
      {fingers.map((fz, i) => {
        const c = i === 0 ? h.index : h.curl * (1 + 0.08 * i);
        const jit = tr * Math.sin(t * 41 + i * 1.7);
        const a = -s * (c * 1.45 + jit);
        const sp = (i - 1.5) * 0.09 * h.spread;
        const L = lens[i];
        return (
          <group key={i} position={[0, -0.091, fz]} rotation={new Euler(sp, 0, a, "XZY")}>
            <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0095, 0.03 * L)} material={m.skin} position={[0, -0.022 * L, 0]} castShadow={cs} />
            <group position={[0, -0.045 * L, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, a * 0.95]}>
              <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0089, 0.021 * L)} material={m.skin} position={[0, -0.016 * L, 0]} castShadow={cs} />
            </group>
          </group>
        );
      })}
      <group position={[-s * 0.006, -0.024, 0.037]} rotation={new Euler(0.55 - 0.3 * h.thumb, 0, -s * (0.3 + h.thumb * 0.85))}>
        <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0115, 0.034)} material={m.skin} position={[0, -0.025, 0]} castShadow={cs} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

const ArmSide: React.FC<{ s: number; sk: Skeleton; hand: Hand; spec: CharacterSpec; m: CharMats; t: number; tremble: number; cs: boolean; children?: React.ReactNode }> = ({ s, sk, hand, spec, m, t, tremble, cs, children }) => {
  const rig = s > 0 ? sk.armL : sk.armR;
  const short = spec.top.sleeve === "short";
  const jit = tremble * 0.04;
  return (
    <J m={rig.shoulder}>
      <mesh geometry={sphere(0.064, 20, 14)} material={m.top} scale={[0.95, 0.8, 0.95]} castShadow={cs} />
      {short ? (
        <>
          <mesh geometry={limb(0.13, 0.077, 0.072, 0.004)} material={m.top} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={torus(0.07, 0.008, 8, 28)} material={m.top} position={[0, -0.135, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
          <mesh geometry={limb(DIMS.upperArm, 0.051, 0.043, 0.004)} material={m.skin} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
        </>
      ) : (
        <mesh geometry={limb(DIMS.upperArm, 0.066, 0.056, 0.006)} material={m.top} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
      )}
      <J m={rig.elbow}>
        {short ? (
          <mesh geometry={limb(DIMS.foreArm, 0.044, 0.034, 0.007)} material={m.skin} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
        ) : (
          <>
            <mesh geometry={limb(DIMS.foreArm - 0.02, 0.055, 0.047, 0.004)} material={m.top} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
            <mesh geometry={cyl(0.044, 0.042, 0.036, 20)} material={spec.top.kind === "hoodie" ? m.topTrim : m.top} position={[0, -DIMS.foreArm + 0.025, 0]} castShadow={cs} />
            <mesh geometry={limb(0.05, 0.034, 0.032)} material={m.skin} position={[0, -DIMS.foreArm + 0.05, 0]} />
          </>
        )}
        <J m={rig.wrist}>
          <group scale={spec.handScale} rotation={[jit * Math.sin(t * 37), 0, jit * Math.sin(t * 29 + 1)]}>
            <HandMesh s={s} h={hand} m={m} t={t} tremble={tremble} cs={cs} />
            {children}
          </group>
        </J>
      </J>
    </J>
  );
};

const LegSide: React.FC<{ s: number; sk: Skeleton; spec: CharacterSpec; m: CharMats; cs: boolean }> = ({ s, sk, spec, m, cs }) => {
  const rig = s > 0 ? sk.legL : sk.legR;
  const shorts = spec.bottom.kind === "shorts";
  return (
    <J m={rig.hip}>
      <mesh geometry={limb(shorts ? 0.22 : DIMS.thigh, 0.094, 0.072, 0.006)} material={m.bottom} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
      {shorts ? <mesh geometry={limb(DIMS.thigh, 0.066, 0.054)} material={m.skin} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow /> : null}
      <J m={rig.knee}>
        <mesh geometry={limb(DIMS.shin, 0.07, 0.054, 0.012)} material={shorts ? m.skin : m.bottom} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
        {!shorts ? <mesh geometry={cyl(0.058, 0.062, 0.05, 20)} material={m.bottom} position={[0, -DIMS.shin + 0.04, 0]} /> : null}
        <J m={rig.ankle}>
          {spec.feet.kind === "shoes" ? (
            <>
              <mesh geometry={box(0.108, 0.034, 0.28, 0.014)} material={m.sole} position={[0, -0.07, 0.055]} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
              <mesh geometry={box(0.1, 0.082, 0.24, 0.036)} material={m.foot} position={[0, -0.034, 0.045]} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
            </>
          ) : (
            <mesh geometry={box(0.09, 0.07, 0.24, 0.034)} material={m.foot} position={[0, -0.055, 0.05]} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
          )}
        </J>
      </J>
    </J>
  );
};

/** Lathe profile [radius, y] of a hijab's drape in neck space, top to bottom. */
const HIJAB_DRAPE: [number, number][] = [[0.07, 0.13], [0.085, 0.08], [0.115, 0.035], [0.16, -0.005], [0.195, -0.045], [0.212, -0.09], [0.218, -0.14], [0.216, -0.19], [0.2, -0.205]];

export type CharacterProps = {
  pose: Pose;
  spec: CharacterSpec;
  t: number;
  variant?: Variant;
  shadows?: boolean;
  visible?: boolean;
  /** extra objects held in each hand (hand space, palm faces −X for the left hand) */
  holdL?: React.ReactNode;
  holdR?: React.ReactNode;
};

export const Character: React.FC<CharacterProps> = ({ pose, spec, t, variant = "hero", shadows = true, visible = true, holdL, holdR }) => {
  const m = charMats(spec, variant);
  const sk = skeleton(pose, spec, t);
  const cs = shadows;
  const bw = spec.build;
  const breathS = 1 + 0.012 * pose.breath * Math.sin(t * pose.breathRate * Math.PI * 2);
  return (
    <group visible={visible}>
      <J m={sk.root}>
        <J m={sk.hips}>
          <mesh geometry={lathe("cfpelvis", PELVIS, 40)} material={m.bottom} scale={[bw, 1, 0.7]} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
          {spec.bottom.kind === "skirt" ? <mesh geometry={cyl(0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 40, true)} material={m.skirt} position={[0, -0.17, 0.0]} scale={[bw, 1, 0.82]} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow /> : null}
          <J m={sk.spine}>
            <J m={sk.chest}>
              <mesh geometry={lathe("cftorso", TORSO, 48)} material={m.top} scale={[bw, 1, 0.67 * breathS]} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
              {spec.top.kind === "hoodie" ? (
                <mesh geometry={torus(0.085, 0.034, 12, 36, Math.PI * 1.55)} material={m.top} position={[0, 0.262, -0.018]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, Math.PI * 1.225]} scale={[1.08, 1, 1.15]} castShadow={cs} />
              ) : spec.top.kind === "shirt" ? (
                <>
                  <mesh geometry={torus(0.07, 0.016, 8, 30)} material={m.topTrim} position={[0, 0.268, 0.004]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2 + 0.12, 0, 0]} />
                  {[1, -1].map((s) => (
                    <mesh key={s} geometry={box(0.05, 0.004, 0.06, 0.002)} material={m.topTrim} position={[s * 0.035, 0.255, 0.075]} rotation={[0.9, s * 0.5, s * 0.4]} />
                  ))}
                  <mesh geometry={box(0.012, 0.5, 0.004, 0.002)} material={m.topTrim} position={[0, 0.0, 0.137]} />
                </>
              ) : (
                <mesh geometry={torus(0.069, 0.0105, 8, 32)} material={m.topTrim} position={[0, 0.27, 0.006]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2 + 0.16, 0, 0]} scale={[1, 0.86, 1]} />
              )}
              <J m={sk.neck}>
                <mesh geometry={cyl(0.056, 0.062, 0.12, 24)} material={m.skin} position={[0, 0.035, 0]} castShadow={cs} />
                {spec.hairStyle === "hijab" ? (
                  // the hijab's drape: from under the chin over the neck and the tops of the shoulders
                  // soft fall over the shoulders: snug at the neck, rounding over the shoulder line, then hanging down
                  <mesh geometry={lathe("cfhijabdrape", HIJAB_DRAPE, 48)} material={m.scarf} position={[0, 0, 0.008]} scale={[bw, 1, 0.96]} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
                ) : null}
                <J m={sk.head}>
                  <J m={sk.headGeo}>
                    <Head f={pose.face} spec={spec} m={m} shadows={cs} />
                  </J>
                </J>
              </J>
              <ArmSide s={1} sk={sk} hand={pose.handL} spec={spec} m={m} t={t} tremble={pose.tremble} cs={cs}>{holdL}</ArmSide>
              <ArmSide s={-1} sk={sk} hand={pose.handR} spec={spec} m={m} t={t + 3.1} tremble={pose.tremble} cs={cs}>{holdR}</ArmSide>
            </J>
          </J>
          <LegSide s={1} sk={sk} spec={spec} m={m} cs={cs} />
          <LegSide s={-1} sk={sk} spec={spec} m={m} cs={cs} />
        </J>
      </J>
    </group>
  );
};

==== 21161 src/kits/characterflow/character/Head.tsx
// Stylised head + face rig. Units are "head units" (the unscaled head is ~0.21 m wide); the parent
// scales by spec.headScale. Features are placed on the actual skull surface (a ray-cast lookup built
// once), so brows, mouth, nose and blush sit on the skin for any expression instead of floating.
//
// Face controls (pose.ts › Face): brows (up / inner / asym), lids (open → wide, squint), gaze, mouth
// (smile, open, wide) and blush. The mouth is a live mesh with fixed topology — never re-allocated.

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  BufferAttribute,
  BufferGeometry,
  CapsuleGeometry,
  DoubleSide,
  Mesh,
  MeshBasicMaterial,
  Quaternion,
  Raycaster,
  SphereGeometry,
  Vector3,
} from "three";
import { cached, sphere, torus } from "../lib/geo.ts";
import type { CharMats } from "./materials.ts";
import type { Face } from "./pose.ts";
import type { CharacterSpec, V3 } from "./spec.ts";

// ── skull ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const HEAD_R: V3 = [0.106, 0.114, 0.108];

/** Unit-sphere point → stylised skull (soft square jaw, full cheeks, rounded cranium). */
export const skull = (x: number, y: number, z: number): V3 => {
  const low = Math.max(0, -y);
  x *= 1 - 0.1 * Math.pow(low, 1.6) - 0.05 * low * low * Math.max(0, z);
  z += 0.08 * low * Math.max(0, z) * Math.max(0, z);
  y *= 1 - 0.04 * low;
  const cheek = Math.exp(-((y + 0.25) ** 2) / 0.06) * Math.max(0, z) * 0.09;
  x *= 1 + cheek;
  z *= 1 - 0.035 * Math.max(0, y) * Math.max(0, z);
  if (z < 0 && y > -0.2) z *= 1 + 0.06 * (y + 0.2);
  return [x * HEAD_R[0], y * HEAD_R[1], z * HEAD_R[2]];
};

export const headGeo = () =>
  cached("cf-head", () => {
    const g = new SphereGeometry(1, 96, 72);
    const a = g.attributes.position;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) {
      const [x, y, z] = skull(a.getX(i), a.getY(i), a.getZ(i));
      a.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
    }
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });

// Surface lookup over the face: z (and normal) of the skin at (x, y), front side.
type Surf = { z: (x: number, y: number) => number; n: (x: number, y: number) => Vector3 };
let surf: Surf | null = null;
const surface = (): Surf => {
  if (surf) return surf;
  const mesh = new Mesh(headGeo(), new MeshBasicMaterial({ side: DoubleSide }));
  mesh.updateMatrixWorld();
  const rc = new Raycaster();
  const X0 = -0.1, X1 = 0.1, Y0 = -0.13, Y1 = 0.12, NX = 41, NY = 51;
  const Z = new Float32Array(NX * NY);
  for (let j = 0; j < NY; j++)
    for (let i = 0; i < NX; i++) {
      const x = X0 + ((X1 - X0) * i) / (NX - 1), y = Y0 + ((Y1 - Y0) * j) / (NY - 1);
      rc.set(new Vector3(x, y, 1), new Vector3(0, 0, -1));
      const hit = rc.intersectObject(mesh, false)[0];
      Z[j * NX + i] = hit ? hit.point.z : 0;
    }
  const z = (x: number, y: number) => {
    const fi = Math.min(NX - 1.001, Math.max(0, ((x - X0) / (X1 - X0)) * (NX - 1)));
    const fj = Math.min(NY - 1.001, Math.max(0, ((y - Y0) / (Y1 - Y0)) * (NY - 1)));
    const i = Math.floor(fi), j = Math.floor(fj), u = fi - i, v = fj - j;
    const a = Z[j * NX + i], b = Z[j * NX + i + 1], c = Z[(j + 1) * NX + i], d = Z[(j + 1) * NX + i + 1];
    return (a * (1 - u) + b * u) * (1 - v) + (c * (1 - u) + d * u) * v;
  };
  const n = (x: number, y: number) => {
    const e = 0.002;
    const dzx = (z(x + e, y) - z(x - e, y)) / (2 * e), dzy = (z(x, y + e) - z(x, y - e)) / (2 * e);
    return new Vector3(-dzx, -dzy, 1).normalize();
  };
  surf = { z, n };
  return surf;
};

const onSkin = (x: number, y: number, lift = 0): V3 => {
  const s = surface();
  const nn = s.n(x, y);
  return [x + nn.x * lift, y + nn.y * lift, s.z(x, y) + nn.z * lift];
};
const skinQuat = (x: number, y: number) => new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new Vector3(0, 0, 1), surface().n(x, y));

// ── features ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const EYE = { x: 0.041, y: 0.004, z: 0.0765, r: 0.0262 };
const LID_R = EYE.r * 1.058;

/** Tapered, arched brow along +x from the inner end (thick) to the outer end (thin). */
const browGeo = () =>
  cached("cf-brow", () => {
    const N = 14, M = 10, L = 0.044;
    const pos: number[] = [], idx: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
      const u = i / N;
      const r = 0.0068 * (1 - 0.55 * u) * (0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, u * 1.6)));
      const cx = u * L, cy = 0.006 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u * 0.9) - 0.002 * u, cz = -0.012 * u * u;
      for (let j = 0; j < M; j++) {
        const a = (j / M) * Math.PI * 2;
        pos.push(cx, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.75, cz + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.55);
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++)
      for (let j = 0; j < M; j++) {
        const a = i * M + j, b = i * M + ((j + 1) % M), c = (i + 1) * M + j, d = (i + 1) * M + ((j + 1) % M);
        idx.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
      }
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(pos), 3));
    g.setIndex(idx);
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });

const capsule = (r: number, l: number) => cached(`cfcap${r},${l}`, () => new CapsuleGeometry(r, l, 6, 14));

// ── the mouth (dynamic) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const MN = 28;
type MouthGeos = { inner: BufferGeometry; line: BufferGeometry; teeth: BufferGeometry; tongue: BufferGeometry };
const strip = () => {
  const g = new BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array((MN + 1) * 2 * 3), 3));
  const idx: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < MN; i++) idx.push(i * 2, i * 2 + 1, i * 2 + 2, i * 2 + 1, i * 2 + 3, i * 2 + 2);
  g.setIndex(idx);
  return g;
};
const setStrip = (g: BufferGeometry, top: (u: number) => [number, number], bot: (u: number) => [number, number], lift: number) => {
  const p = g.attributes.position as BufferAttribute;
  for (let i = 0; i <= MN; i++) {
    const u = (i / MN) * 2 - 1;
    const [x0, y0] = top(u), [x1, y1] = bot(u);
    const a = onSkin(x0, y0, lift), b = onSkin(x1, y1, lift);
    p.setXYZ(i * 2, a[0], a[1], a[2]);
    p.setXYZ(i * 2 + 1, b[0], b[1], b[2]);
  }
  p.needsUpdate = true;
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  g.computeBoundingSphere();
};

const Mouth: React.FC<{ f: Face; m: CharMats }> = ({ f, m }) => {
  const geos = useMemo<MouthGeos>(() => ({ inner: strip(), line: strip(), teeth: strip(), tongue: strip() }), []);
  useLayoutEffect(() => () => { for (const g of Object.values(geos)) g.dispose(); }, [geos]);
  const Y = -0.061;
  const half = 0.02 * (1 + 0.3 * f.wide + 0.12 * Math.max(0, f.smile)) * (1 - 0.15 * f.open);
  const c = 0.0085 * f.smile + 0.003 * Math.min(0, f.wide);
  const op = Math.max(0, f.open);
  const yU = (u: number) => Y + c * u * u + op * 0.0035 * (1 - u * u) + 0.0012 * Math.max(0, f.smile) * (1 - u * u);
  const yL = (u: number) => Y + c * u * u - op * (0.017 + 0.004 * f.wide) * Math.pow(1 - u * u, 0.85) - 0.0035 * Math.max(0, f.smile) * Math.pow(1 - u * u, 1.4) * (0.4 + op);
  const xx = (u: number) => u * half;
  const lw = 0.0021 + 0.0006 * (1 - op);
  setStrip(geos.inner, (u) => [xx(u), yU(u)], (u) => [xx(u), yL(u)], 0.0006);
  setStrip(geos.line, (u) => [xx(u) * 1.02, yU(u) + lw * 0.5 * (1 - 0.6 * u * u)], (u) => [xx(u) * 1.02, yU(u) - lw * 0.5 * (1 - 0.6 * u * u)], 0.0011);
  const th = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, op - 0.15) * 3) * 0.0055;
  setStrip(geos.teeth, (u) => [xx(u) * 0.8, yU(u * 0.8) - 0.0008], (u) => [xx(u) * 0.8, yU(u * 0.8) - 0.0008 - th * (1 - u * u * 0.6)], 0.0009);
  const tg = op * 0.006;
  setStrip(geos.tongue, (u) => [xx(u) * 0.62, yL(u * 0.62) + tg], (u) => [xx(u) * 0.62, yL(u * 0.62) + 0.0004], 0.0009);
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={geos.inner} material={m.mouth} visible={op > 0.02 || f.smile > 0.3} />
      <mesh geometry={geos.teeth} material={m.teeth} visible={op > 0.17} />
      <mesh geometry={geos.tongue} material={m.tongue} visible={op > 0.25} />
      <mesh geometry={geos.line} material={m.lipLine} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── hair ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// A sculpted shell over the skull (one smooth mesh with lock grooves, a scalloped hairline and a
// front quiff) plus a few hero locks for the silhouette — clean stylised hair, no spikes.
const sstep = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => { const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return k * k * (3 - 2 * k); };
const table = (pts: [number, number][], x: number) => {
  if (x <= pts[0][0]) return pts[0][1];
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++)
    if (x <= pts[i][0]) { const k = (x - pts[i - 1][0]) / (pts[i][0] - pts[i - 1][0]); const u = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * k); return pts[i - 1][1] + (pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1]) * u; }
  return pts[pts.length - 1][1];
};
type HairCfg = { line: [number, number][]; base: number; top: number; quiff: number; groove: number; scallop: number; fringe: number; curls?: number };
const HAIR: Record<CharacterSpec["hairStyle"], HairCfg> = {
  swoop: { line: [[0, 0.42], [0.75, 0.37], [1.15, 0.22], [1.45, 0.17], [1.75, 0.12], [2.3, -0.18], [Math.PI, -0.5]], base: 0.007, top: 0.016, quiff: 0.024, groove: 0.3, scallop: 0.045, fringe: 1 },
  crop: { line: [[0, 0.5], [0.8, 0.44], [1.2, 0.26], [1.5, 0.2], [1.8, 0.14], [2.4, -0.2], [Math.PI, -0.45]], base: 0.006, top: 0.012, quiff: 0.006, groove: 0.12, scallop: 0.02, fringe: 0 },
  bun: { line: [[0, 0.46], [0.8, 0.4], [1.2, 0.18], [1.5, 0.1], [1.8, 0.0], [2.4, -0.3], [Math.PI, -0.55]], base: 0.01, top: 0.016, quiff: 0.004, groove: 0.1, scallop: 0.015, fringe: 0 },
  curly: { line: [[0, 0.44], [0.8, 0.4], [1.2, 0.22], [1.5, 0.18], [1.8, 0.12], [2.4, -0.14], [Math.PI, -0.42]], base: 0.015, top: 0.022, quiff: 0.0, groove: 0, scallop: 0.025, fringe: 0, curls: 0.3 },
  // shoulder-length: a side-parted cap that comes down over the ears (the back mass is added in Head)
  long: { line: [[0, 0.4], [0.7, 0.3], [1.1, 0.0], [1.4, -0.35], [1.8, -0.55], [2.4, -0.7], [Math.PI, -0.75]], base: 0.012, top: 0.018, quiff: 0.008, groove: 0.14, scallop: 0.0, fringe: 0.6 },
  // a hijab is its own shell (hijabShell); this entry only satisfies the table
  hijab: { line: [[0, 0.46], [Math.PI, -0.5]], base: 0.01, top: 0.01, quiff: 0, groove: 0, scallop: 0, fringe: 0 },
};

/**
 * Hijab: a smooth cloth shell over the whole head that leaves an oval for the face (forehead to chin,
 * cheek to cheek) and wraps down past the jaw at the sides and back; the drape over the neck and
 * shoulders hangs from the neck (Character.tsx), so the head can turn inside it.
 */
export const hijabShell = () =>
  cached("cf-hijab", () => {
    const NA = 200, NT = 60;
    const pos: number[] = [];
    // lowest covered elevation per azimuth: high at the face, deep everywhere else
    const rim = (az: number) => table([[0, 0.5], [0.55, 0.44], [0.78, 0.05], [0.95, -0.75], [1.15, -1.2], [1.5, -1.32], [Math.PI, -1.32]], Math.abs(az));
    for (let j = -2; j <= NT; j++) {
      for (let i = 0; i < NA; i++) {
        const az = -Math.PI + (i / NA) * Math.PI * 2;
        const H = rim(az);
        const t = Math.max(0, j / NT);
        const el = H + (Math.PI / 2 - H) * Math.pow(t, 0.9);
        const ux = Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el), uy = Math.sin(el), uz = Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el);
        const [sx, sy, sz] = skull(ux, uy, uz);
        const r = Math.hypot(sx, sy, sz);
        // a soft fold where the cloth meets the face, fuller over the crown and the back
        const th = 0.011 + 0.008 * Math.max(0, uy) + 0.006 * Math.max(0, -uz) + 0.004 * sstep(0.9, 0.6, Math.abs(az));
        const lip = j < 0 ? -0.004 * (-j) : th * Math.sqrt(sstep(0, 0.1, t)) + 0.0015;
        const k = (r + lip) / r;
        pos.push(sx * k, sy * k, sz * k);
      }
    }
    const rows = NT + 3, idx: number[] = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < rows - 1; j++)
      for (let i = 0; i < NA; i++) {
        const a0 = j * NA + i, a1 = j * NA + ((i + 1) % NA), b0 = (j + 1) * NA + i, b1 = (j + 1) * NA + ((i + 1) % NA);
        idx.push(a0, a1, b0, a1, b1, b0);
      }
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(pos), 3));
    g.setIndex(idx);
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });

export const hairShell = (style: CharacterSpec["hairStyle"]) =>
  cached(`cf-hair-${style}`, () => {
    // Parametric cap: columns around the head (az), rows from the hairline (t = 0) to the crown
    // (t = 1). The rim is an explicit smooth curve with a rounded lip tucked under the skin.
    const C = HAIR[style];
    const NA = 220, NT = 70;
    const pos: number[] = [];
    const hairline = (az: number) => {
      const A = Math.abs(az);
      let H = table(C.line, A) + C.scallop * Math.sin(az * 11 + 0.6) * sstep(1.9, 0.4, A);
      return H - C.fringe * 0.1 * Math.exp(-((az + 0.32) ** 2) / 0.09);
    };
    for (let j = -2; j <= NT; j++) {
      for (let i = 0; i < NA; i++) {
        const az = -Math.PI + (i / NA) * Math.PI * 2;
        const H = hairline(az);
        const t = Math.max(0, j / NT);
        const el = H + (Math.PI / 2 - H) * Math.pow(t, 0.85);
        const ux = Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el), uy = Math.sin(el), uz = Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el);
        const [sx, sy, sz] = skull(ux, uy, uz);
        const r = Math.hypot(sx, sy, sz);
        let th = C.base + C.top * Math.pow(Math.max(0, uy), 0.9);
        const qd = (ux + 0.12) ** 2 + (uy - 0.68) ** 2 + (uz - 0.72) ** 2;
        th += C.quiff * Math.exp(-qd / 0.12);
        th *= 1 + C.groove * Math.sin(ux * 14 + uz * 6 - uy * 5) * sstep(0, 0.25, t) * sstep(0.97, 0.8, uy);
        // tight curls: overlapping round bumps (3-D lattice, no seams)
        if (C.curls) th *= 1 + C.curls * Math.sin(ux * 13) * Math.sin(uy * 13 + 1.3) * Math.sin(uz * 13 + 0.7) * sstep(0, 0.12, t);
        // rounded lip: thickness rises quickly from the rim; rows j < 0 tuck under the skin
        const lip = j < 0 ? -0.004 * (-j) : th * Math.sqrt(sstep(0, 0.07, t)) + 0.0012;
        const k = (r + lip) / r;
        pos.push(sx * k, sy * k, sz * k);
      }
    }
    const rows = NT + 3;
    const idx: number[] = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < rows - 1; j++)
      for (let i = 0; i < NA; i++) {
        const a0 = j * NA + i, a1 = j * NA + ((i + 1) % NA), b0 = (j + 1) * NA + i, b1 = (j + 1) * NA + ((i + 1) % NA);
        idx.push(a0, a1, b0, a1, b1, b0);
      }
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(pos), 3));
    g.setIndex(idx);
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });

// ── head ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const Head: React.FC<{ f: Face; spec: CharacterSpec; m: CharMats; shadows: boolean }> = ({ f, spec, m, shadows }) => {
  // upper lid edge sits ~32° above the eye centre when open (lid = 1), closes at 0, opens wider above 1
  const low = 0.95 - 0.55 * f.squint - 0.25 * Math.max(0, f.smile);
  const lidA = Math.min(low - 0.02, Math.max(-1.1, Math.PI / 2 - 2.13 * f.lid));
  const lowA = Math.PI + low;
  const cs = shadows;
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={headGeo()} material={m.skin} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
      {/* ears */}
      {[1, -1].map((s) => (
        <group key={`ear${s}`} position={[s * 0.101, -0.012, -0.004]} rotation={[0, s * 0.35, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={sphere(0.034, 20, 14)} material={m.skin} scale={[0.36, 0.92, 0.66]} castShadow={cs} />
          <mesh geometry={sphere(0.02, 14, 10)} material={m.skin} position={[s * 0.006, -0.002, 0.004]} scale={[0.3, 0.8, 0.5]} />
        </group>
      ))}
      {/* nose */}
      <mesh geometry={sphere(0.0135, 24, 16)} material={m.skin} position={onSkin(0, -0.03, 0.0045)} scale={[1.1, 0.88, 0.95]} castShadow={cs} />
      <mesh geometry={sphere(0.009, 16, 12)} material={m.skin} position={onSkin(0, -0.012, -0.0005)} scale={[0.8, 1.45, 0.7]} />
      {[1, -1].map((s) => (
        <mesh key={`nos${s}`} geometry={sphere(0.0058, 14, 10)} material={m.skin} position={onSkin(s * 0.0098, -0.0335, 0.0)} />
      ))}
      {/* cheeks blush */}
      {[1, -1].map((s) => (
        <mesh key={`bl${s}`} geometry={cached("cf-blushplane", () => new SphereGeometry(1, 16, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2))} material={m.blush}
          position={onSkin(s * 0.056, -0.034, 0.0015)} quaternion={skinQuat(s * 0.056, -0.034).multiply(new Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new Vector3(1, 0, 0), Math.PI / 2))}
          scale={[0.024 * (1 + 0.2 * f.blush), 0.001, 0.016 * (1 + 0.2 * f.blush)]} />
      ))}
      {/* eyes */}
      {[1, -1].map((s) => {
        const tilt = -s * 0.12 * f.browIn;
        return (
          <group key={`eye${s}`} position={[s * EYE.x, EYE.y, EYE.z]}>
            <mesh geometry={sphere(EYE.r, 40, 28)} material={m.eye} rotation={[-f.eyeY, f.eyeX, 0]} />
            {/* catchlights stay fixed to the head (the eye turns under them) */}
            <mesh visible={f.lid > 0.74} geometry={sphere(0.0026, 10, 8)} material={m.glint} position={[s * -0.007 + 0.002, 0.009, EYE.r * 0.88]} />
            <mesh visible={f.lid > 0.74} geometry={sphere(0.0013, 8, 6)} material={m.glint} position={[s * 0.006, -0.006, EYE.r * 0.93]} />
            <group rotation={[0, 0, tilt]}>
              <group rotation={[lidA, 0, 0]}>
                <mesh geometry={sphere(LID_R, 36, 14, Math.PI * 2, Math.PI / 2)} material={m.skin} />
                <mesh geometry={torus(LID_R, 0.0024, 6, 40, Math.PI)} material={m.lash} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
                {/* outer lash flick */}
                <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0019, 0.006)} material={m.lash} position={[s * LID_R * 0.96, 0, LID_R * 0.18]} rotation={[0, 0, s * 1.05]} />
              </group>
              <group rotation={[lowA, 0, 0]}>
                <mesh geometry={sphere(LID_R * 0.995, 36, 12, Math.PI * 2, Math.PI / 2)} material={m.skin} />
              </group>
            </group>
          </group>
        );
      })}
      {/* brows */}
      {[1, -1].map((s) => {
        const up = 0.0085 * f.browUp + s * 0.006 * f.browAsym;
        const bx = s * 0.0225, by = 0.041 + up + 0.0035 * f.browIn;
        const a = -s * 0.3 * f.browIn + s * 0.08;
        const pos = onSkin(bx, by, 0.0035);
        return (
          <group key={`br${s}`} position={pos} rotation={[-0.18, s * 0.2, a]} scale={[s, 1, 1]}>
            <mesh geometry={browGeo()} material={m.brow} castShadow={cs} />
          </group>
        );
      })}
      <Mouth f={f} m={m} />
      {/* hair */}
      {spec.hairStyle === "hijab" ? (
        <mesh geometry={hijabShell()} material={m.scarf} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
      ) : (
        <mesh geometry={hairShell(spec.hairStyle)} material={m.hair} castShadow={cs} receiveShadow />
      )}
      {spec.hairStyle === "bun" ? <mesh geometry={sphere(0.055, 24, 16)} material={m.hair} position={[0, 0.1, -0.09]} castShadow={cs} /> : null}
      {spec.hairStyle === "long" ? (
        <>
          <mesh geometry={sphere(1, 32, 20)} material={m.hair} position={[0, -0.045, -0.042]} scale={[0.108, 0.135, 0.085]} castShadow={cs} />
          {[1, -1].map((s) => <mesh key={`lk${s}`} geometry={sphere(1, 20, 14)} material={m.hair} position={[s * 0.088, -0.07, -0.022]} scale={[0.026, 0.085, 0.05]} rotation={[0.15, 0, s * 0.08]} castShadow={cs} />)}
        </>
      ) : null}
      {spec.moustache ? [1, -1].map((s) => <mesh key={`mo${s}`} geometry={sphere(1, 20, 12)} material={m.brow} position={onSkin(s * 0.0125, -0.046, 0.0005)} quaternion={skinQuat(s * 0.0125, -0.046)} rotation={[0, 0, s * -0.18]} scale={[0.0155, 0.0062, 0.006]} />) : null}
      {spec.beard ? <mesh geometry={cached("cf-beard", () => new SphereGeometry(1, 40, 20, Math.PI * 1.15, Math.PI * 0.7, Math.PI * 0.6, Math.PI * 0.3))} material={m.hair} position={[0, 0.004, 0.002]} scale={[0.103, 0.121, 0.109]} /> : null}
      {spec.glasses ? (
        <group>
          {[1, -1].map((s) => (
            <group key={`gl${s}`}>
              <mesh geometry={torus(0.031, 0.0032, 8, 36)} material={m.frame} position={[s * EYE.x, EYE.y, EYE.z + EYE.r + 0.01]} />
              <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0025, 0.08)} material={m.frame} position={[s * 0.085, EYE.y + 0.004, 0.06]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
            </group>
          ))}
          <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0026, 0.016)} material={m.frame} position={[0, EYE.y + 0.006, EYE.z + EYE.r + 0.012]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
        </group>
      ) : null}
    </group>
  );
};

==== 5800 src/kits/characterflow/character/materials.ts
// One material set per (character, variant). "hero" materials are opaque; "mini" materials (the
// little imagined versions of the cast inside thought bubbles) can be faded and tinted together
// without touching the lead's look.

import { Color, DoubleSide, type MeshPhysicalMaterial, type Material, MeshBasicMaterial } from "three";
import { canvasTex, eyeTex, mulberry32, phys, shade, weaveTex } from "../lib/mats.ts";
import type { CharacterSpec } from "./spec.ts";

export type Variant = "hero" | "mini";

export type CharMats = {
  skin: MeshPhysicalMaterial; hair: MeshPhysicalMaterial; scarf: MeshPhysicalMaterial; top: MeshPhysicalMaterial; topTrim: MeshPhysicalMaterial;
  bottom: MeshPhysicalMaterial; skirt: MeshPhysicalMaterial; foot: MeshPhysicalMaterial; sole: MeshPhysicalMaterial;
  eye: MeshPhysicalMaterial; lash: MeshPhysicalMaterial; brow: MeshPhysicalMaterial;
  mouth: MeshPhysicalMaterial; lipLine: MeshPhysicalMaterial; teeth: MeshPhysicalMaterial; tongue: MeshPhysicalMaterial;
  blush: MeshBasicMaterial; glint: MeshBasicMaterial; frame: MeshPhysicalMaterial; nail: MeshPhysicalMaterial;
  all: Material[];
};

const sets = new Map<string, CharMats>();

/** Soft knit for t-shirts: fine rib + a few slubs. */
const knitTex = (key: string, color: string) =>
  canvasTex(`knit${key}`, 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(17);
    g.fillStyle = color;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 3) {
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(${x % 6 ? "255,255,255" : "0,0,0"},0.035)`;
      g.fillRect(x, 0, 1.5, h);
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < 90; k++) {
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(${r() > 0.5 ? "255,255,255" : "60,40,20"},${0.03 + r() * 0.04})`;
      g.fillRect(r() * w, r() * h, 1 + r() * 2, 6 + r() * 18);
    }
  }, [5, 5]);

export const charMats = (spec: CharacterSpec, variant: Variant = "hero"): CharMats => {
  const key = `${spec.id}:${variant}`;
  let s = sets.get(key);
  if (s) return s;
  const k = (n: string) => `${key}:${n}`;
  const fabric = { roughness: 0.82, sheen: 0.55, sheenRoughness: 0.55 };
  const skin = phys(k("skin"), { color: spec.skin, roughness: 0.48, sheen: 0.45, sheenColor: "#ffb196", sheenRoughness: 0.45, clearcoat: 0.12, clearcoatRoughness: 0.5 });
  const hair = phys(k("hair"), { color: spec.hair, roughness: 0.46, sheen: 1, sheenColor: spec.hairSheen, sheenRoughness: 0.35, clearcoat: 0.12, clearcoatRoughness: 0.5 });
  const scarf = phys(k("scarf"), { color: spec.scarf ?? spec.hair, roughness: 0.85, sheen: 0.7, sheenColor: shade(spec.scarf ?? spec.hair, 1.5), sheenRoughness: 0.5, side: DoubleSide });
  const top = phys(k("top"), { color: "#ffffff", map: spec.top.kind === "hoodie" ? weaveTex(`${spec.id}top`, spec.top.color, [6, 6]) : knitTex(spec.id, spec.top.color), sheenColor: shade(spec.top.color, 1.3), ...fabric });
  const topTrim = phys(k("trim"), { color: spec.top.accent, sheenColor: "#ffffff", ...fabric });
  const bottom = phys(k("bottom"), { color: spec.bottom.color, sheenColor: shade(spec.bottom.color, 2.2), ...fabric, roughness: 0.78 });
  const skirt = phys(k("skirt"), { color: spec.bottom.color, sheenColor: shade(spec.bottom.color, 2.2), ...fabric, roughness: 0.78, side: DoubleSide });
  const foot = phys(k("foot"), { color: spec.feet.kind === "bare" ? spec.skin : spec.feet.color, ...fabric, roughness: spec.feet.kind === "shoes" ? 0.5 : 0.85 });
  const sole = phys(k("sole"), { color: "#4a4a50", roughness: 0.8 });
  const eye = phys(k("eye"), { map: eyeTex(spec.id, spec.iris), roughness: 0.04, clearcoat: 1, clearcoatRoughness: 0.02 });
  const lash = phys(k("lash"), { color: shade(spec.hair, 0.6), roughness: 0.6 });
  const brow = phys(k("brow"), { color: spec.brow, roughness: 0.75, sheen: 0.4, sheenColor: spec.hairSheen });
  const decal = { polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -4, polygonOffsetUnits: -4, side: DoubleSide };
  const mouth = phys(k("mouth"), { color: "#5a2226", roughness: 0.7, ...decal });
  const lipLine = phys(k("lip"), { color: shade(spec.lip, 0.62), roughness: 0.55, ...decal, polygonOffsetFactor: -6, polygonOffsetUnits: -6 });
  const teeth = phys(k("teeth"), { color: "#f6f1e8", roughness: 0.3, ...decal, polygonOffsetFactor: -5, polygonOffsetUnits: -5 });
  const tongue = phys(k("tongue"), { color: "#c4636a", roughness: 0.5, ...decal, polygonOffsetFactor: -5, polygonOffsetUnits: -5 });
  const blush = new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new Color("#ff6f6a"), transparent: true, opacity: 0.16 * spec.blush, depthWrite: false, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -3, polygonOffsetUnits: -3, map: blushTex() });
  const glint = new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: "#ffffff", toneMapped: false });
  const frame = phys(k("frame"), { color: "#2b2522", roughness: 0.35, clearcoat: 0.6 });
  const nail = phys(k("nail"), { color: shade(spec.skin, 1.18), roughness: 0.3, clearcoat: 0.5 });
  const all: Material[] = [skin, hair, scarf, top, topTrim, bottom, skirt, foot, sole, eye, lash, brow, mouth, lipLine, teeth, tongue, frame, nail];
  s = { skin, hair, scarf, top, topTrim, bottom, skirt, foot, sole, eye, lash, brow, mouth, lipLine, teeth, tongue, blush, glint, frame, nail, all };
  sets.set(key, s);
  return s;
};

const blushTex = () =>
  canvasTex("blush", 128, 128, (g, w, h) => {
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2, 0, w / 2, h / 2, w / 2);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  });

/** Fade every mini material of a character (thought-bubble imagery). */
export const setMiniFade = (spec: CharacterSpec, opacity: number) => {
  const s = charMats(spec, "mini");
  for (const m of s.all) {
    m.opacity = opacity;
    m.transparent = opacity < 0.999;
  }
  s.blush.opacity = 0.16 * spec.blush * opacity;
};

==== 13228 src/kits/characterflow/character/performance.ts
// Performance engine: turns a list of acting beats into a Pose at any time t (pure, no state).
//
// A beat sets any of five independent channels — body, left arm, right arm, face, look — and blends
// into it over `dur` seconds with an acting curve. Channels evaluate live (a moving IK target or a
// run cycle keeps moving during a blend). On top sit the procedural layers that keep a character
// alive between beats: breathing, blinks, eye saccades, idle sway and tremble.
//
// Beats know nothing about a topic: scenes give them times (usually voice-over cues) and presets.

import { bezier, clamp, remap } from "../../../core/motion/easing.ts";
import { hash1, noise1 } from "../lib/rng.ts";
import { BODY, type Anchor, type BodyName } from "./presets/bodies.ts";
import { EXPR, type ExprName } from "./presets/expressions.ts";
import { GESTURE, type Gesture, type GestureName } from "./presets/gestures.ts";
import { blend, clonePose, lerpArm, lerpFace, lerpHand, lerpN, type Face, type Pose } from "./pose.ts";
import { lookAngles, resolveIK } from "./skeleton.ts";
import type { CharacterSpec, V3 } from "./spec.ts";

export const CURVES = {
  /** default acting move: quick start, long settle */
  act: bezier(0.3, 0, 0.15, 1),
  inOut: bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1),
  soft: (t: number) => 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * clamp(t)),
  /** fast with a small overshoot (startle, snap) */
  snap: bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1.18),
  /** anticipation: dips back before going (big body moves) */
  antic: bezier(0.55, -0.22, 0.25, 1.06),
  linear: (t: number) => clamp(t),
};
export type CurveName = keyof typeof CURVES;

type Val<T> = T | ((t: number) => T);
export type BodySel = BodyName | ((t: number) => Pose);
export type GestureSel = GestureName | Gesture | ((t: number) => Gesture);
export type FaceSel = ExprName | Face | { base: ExprName; mix?: ExprName; k?: number; add?: Partial<Face> };
export type LookSel = V3 | ((t: number) => V3) | null;

export type Beat = {
  at: number;
  dur?: number;
  curve?: CurveName;
  body?: BodySel;
  /** tweak the body pose after the preset (live) */
  bodyMod?: (p: Pose, t: number) => void;
  /** null hands the arm back to the body (e.g. the walk's arm swing) */
  armL?: GestureSel | null;
  armR?: GestureSel | null;
  arms?: GestureSel | null;
  face?: FaceSel;
  look?: LookSel;
  /** how far the head follows the look target (0…1; eyes always follow) */
  headFollow?: number;
  breath?: { amp?: number; rate?: number };
  tremble?: number;
  /** eye darting 0…1 */
  nervous?: number;
  blink?: boolean;
  /** deep breath (inhale ≈ 1.1 s, exhale ≈ 1.5 s) starting at `at` */
  sigh?: boolean;
  label?: string;
};

export type Performance = { spec: CharacterSpec; anchor: Val<Anchor>; beats: Beat[] };

// ── generic channel evaluation ───────────────────────────────────────────────
type Ch<T> = { at: number; dur: number; curve: CurveName; v: (t: number) => T };
const channel = <T>(list: Ch<T>[], t: number, mix: (a: T, b: T, k: number) => T, i = -1): T => {
  if (i < 0) {
    i = 0;
    while (i < list.length - 1 && list[i + 1].at <= t) i++;
  }
  const c = list[i];
  const cur = c.v(t);
  if (i === 0) return cur;
  const k = CURVES[c.curve](remap(t, c.at, c.at + Math.max(1e-3, c.dur)));
  if (k >= 1 && t >= c.at + c.dur) return cur;
  return mix(channel(list, t, mix, i - 1), cur, k);
};

const val = <T>(v: Val<T>, t: number): T => (typeof v === "function" ? (v as (t: number) => T)(t) : v);

// ── performance → compiled channels ─────────────────────────────────────────
type Compiled = {
  body: Ch<Pose>[]; armL: Ch<Gesture | null>[]; armR: Ch<Gesture | null>[]; face: Ch<Face>[];
  lookH: Ch<{ p: V3; w: number }>[]; lookE: Ch<{ p: V3; w: number }>[]; follow: Ch<number>[];
  scal: Ch<{ amp: number; rate: number; tremble: number; nervous: number }>[];
  blinks: number[]; sighs: number[];
};

const faceOf = (s: FaceSel): Face => {
  if (typeof s === "string") return EXPR[s];
  if ("base" in s) {
    let f = EXPR[s.base];
    if (s.mix) f = lerpFace(f, EXPR[s.mix], s.k ?? 0.5);
    return { ...f, ...(s.add ?? {}) };
  }
  return s;
};
const gestureOf = (s: GestureSel, t: number): Gesture => (typeof s === "string" ? GESTURE[s] : typeof s === "function" ? s(t) : s);

const cache = new WeakMap<Performance, Compiled>();
const compile = (perf: Performance): Compiled => {
  let c = cache.get(perf);
  if (c) return c;
  const beats = [...perf.beats].sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);
  const spec = perf.spec;
  const anchor = (t: number) => val(perf.anchor, t);
  c = { body: [], armL: [], armR: [], face: [], lookH: [], lookE: [], follow: [], scal: [], blinks: [], sighs: [] };
  let sc = { amp: 1, rate: 0.24, tremble: 0, nervous: 0 };
  for (const b of beats) {
    const dur = b.dur ?? 0.45, curve = b.curve ?? "act";
    if (b.body) {
      const sel = b.body, mod = b.bodyMod;
      c.body.push({ at: b.at, dur, curve, v: (t) => {
        const p = typeof sel === "string" ? clonePose(BODY[sel](anchor(t), spec, t)) : sel(t);
        if (mod) mod(p, t);
        return p;
      } });
    }
    // `null` is a real value (give the arm back to the body), so only `undefined` falls back to `arms`
    const armL = b.armL !== undefined ? b.armL : b.arms, armR = b.armR !== undefined ? b.armR : b.arms;
    if (armL !== undefined) c.armL.push({ at: b.at, dur, curve, v: (t) => (armL === null ? null : gestureOf(armL, t)) });
    if (armR !== undefined) c.armR.push({ at: b.at, dur, curve, v: (t) => (armR === null ? null : gestureOf(armR, t)) });
    if (b.face) {
      const f = faceOf(b.face);
      c.face.push({ at: b.at, dur: b.dur ?? 0.3, curve, v: () => f });
    }
    if (b.look !== undefined) {
      const L = b.look;
      const v = (t: number) => (L === null ? { p: [0, 0, 0] as V3, w: 0 } : { p: val(L, t), w: 1 });
      c.lookH.push({ at: b.at, dur: dur * 1.15, curve: "inOut", v });
      c.lookE.push({ at: b.at, dur: Math.min(0.14, dur), curve: "act", v });
    }
    if (b.headFollow !== undefined) c.follow.push({ at: b.at, dur, curve: "inOut", v: () => b.headFollow! });
    if (b.breath || b.tremble !== undefined || b.nervous !== undefined) {
      sc = { amp: b.breath?.amp ?? sc.amp, rate: b.breath?.rate ?? sc.rate, tremble: b.tremble ?? sc.tremble, nervous: b.nervous ?? sc.nervous };
      const s = sc;
      c.scal.push({ at: b.at, dur: Math.max(0.6, dur), curve: "soft", v: () => s });
    }
    if (b.blink) c.blinks.push(b.at);
    if (b.sigh) c.sighs.push(b.at);
  }
  if (!c.body.length) c.body.push({ at: 0, dur: 0, curve: "act", v: (t) => BODY.stand(anchor(t), spec, t) });
  if (!c.face.length) c.face.push({ at: 0, dur: 0, curve: "act", v: () => EXPR.neutral });
  if (!c.armL.length) c.armL.push({ at: 0, dur: 0, curve: "act", v: () => null });
  if (!c.armR.length) c.armR.push({ at: 0, dur: 0, curve: "act", v: () => null });
  if (!c.lookH.length) { c.lookH.push({ at: 0, dur: 0, curve: "act", v: () => ({ p: [0, 0, 0], w: 0 }) }); c.lookE.push(c.lookH[0]); }
  if (!c.follow.length) c.follow.push({ at: 0, dur: 0, curve: "act", v: () => 0.85 });
  if (!c.scal.length) c.scal.push({ at: 0, dur: 0, curve: "act", v: () => sc });
  cache.set(perf, c);
  return c;
};

// ── procedural life layers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const blinkShape = (dt: number) => (dt < 0 ? 0 : dt < 0.065 ? dt / 0.065 : dt < 0.095 ? 1 : dt < 0.22 ? 1 - (dt - 0.095) / 0.125 : 0);
/** Natural blinks every 2–5 s (deterministic), plus forced ones. */
export const blinkAt = (t: number, forced: number[], seed = 1) => {
  let b = 0;
  for (const f of forced) b = Math.max(b, blinkShape(t - f));
  let tb = 0.7 + hash1(0, seed) * 1.5;
  for (let i = 1; tb <= t + 0.3 && i < 400; i++) {
    b = Math.max(b, blinkShape(t - tb));
    tb += 2.1 + 2.9 * hash1(i, seed);
    if (hash1(i, seed + 7) < 0.15) tb -= 1.7; // occasional double blink
  }
  return b;
};

/** Fixation jumps: piecewise-constant gaze offsets with 50 ms transitions. */
const saccade = (t: number, nervous: number, seed: number): [number, number] => {
  const rate = 0.9 - 0.6 * nervous;
  const i = Math.floor(t / rate), f = t / rate - i;
  const pick = (k: number): [number, number] => [(hash1(k, seed) - 0.5) * 2, (hash1(k, seed + 3) - 0.5) * 2];
  const a = pick(i - 1), b = pick(i);
  const k = clamp(f * rate / 0.05);
  const amp = 0.025 + 0.13 * nervous;
  return [lerpN(a[0], b[0], k) * amp, lerpN(a[1], b[1], k) * amp * 0.6];
};

/** Deep breath envelope at time since start (0…1 inhale, back to 0 on exhale). */
const sighShape = (dt: number) => (dt < 0 ? 0 : dt < 1.1 ? Math.sin((dt / 1.1) * Math.PI / 2) : dt < 2.6 ? Math.cos(((dt - 1.1) / 1.5) * Math.PI / 2) : 0);

const mixGesture = (a: Gesture | null, b: Gesture | null, k: number, base: Gesture): Gesture => {
  const A = a ?? base, B = b ?? base;
  return { arm: lerpArm(A.arm, B.arm, k), hand: lerpHand(A.hand, B.hand, k) };
};

export type Evaluated = { pose: Pose; look: V3 | null };

/** The pose of a performance at time t (seconds). */
export const perform = (perf: Performance, t: number, seed = 1): Evaluated => {
  const c = compile(perf);
  const spec = perf.spec;
  const body = channel(c.body, t, blend);
  const p = clonePose(body);

  // arms: resolve IK targets for this body, then blend like-for-like (chest space)
  const resolveG = (g: Gesture | null, side: 1 | -1): Gesture | null => {
    if (!g) return null;
    if (!g.arm.ik) return g;
    return { arm: { ...g.arm, ik: resolveIK(g.arm.ik, body, spec, side) }, hand: g.hand };
  };
  const baseL: Gesture = { arm: body.armL, hand: body.handL }, baseR: Gesture = { arm: body.armR, hand: body.handR };
  const gl = channel(c.armL.map((x) => ({ ...x, v: (tt: number) => resolveG(x.v(tt), 1) })), t, (a, b, k) => mixGesture(a, b, k, baseL));
  const gr = channel(c.armR.map((x) => ({ ...x, v: (tt: number) => resolveG(x.v(tt), -1) })), t, (a, b, k) => mixGesture(a, b, k, baseR));
  if (gl) { p.armL = gl.arm; p.handL = gl.hand; }
  if (gr) { p.armR = gr.arm; p.handR = gr.hand; }

  p.face = { ...channel(c.face, t, lerpFace) };
  const sc = channel(c.scal, t, (a, b, k) => ({ amp: lerpN(a.amp, b.amp, k), rate: lerpN(a.rate, b.rate, k), tremble: lerpN(a.tremble, b.tremble, k), nervous: lerpN(a.nervous, b.nervous, k) }));
  p.breath = sc.amp * body.breath;
  p.breathRate = sc.rate;
  p.tremble = sc.tremble;

  // deep breaths: shoulders rise, chest opens, head lifts
  let sg = 0;
  for (const s0 of c.sighs) sg = Math.max(sg, sighShape(t - s0));
  if (sg > 0) {
    p.shrug += 0.55 * sg;
    p.chest = [p.chest[0] - 0.07 * sg, p.chest[1], p.chest[2]];
    p.head = [p.head[0] - 0.08 * sg, p.head[1], p.head[2]];
  }
  // breathing shoulders + idle sway (more when nervous)
  const bs = Math.sin(t * p.breathRate * Math.PI * 2);
  p.shrug += 0.07 * p.breath * Math.max(0, bs);
  const sway = 0.012 + 0.02 * sc.nervous;
  p.spine = [p.spine[0] + sway * 0.6 * noise1(t * 0.35, seed), p.spine[1] + sway * noise1(t * 0.27, seed + 1), p.spine[2] + sway * 0.5 * noise1(t * 0.31, seed + 2)];
  p.head = [p.head[0] + sway * 1.4 * noise1(t * 0.5 + 9, seed), p.head[1] + sway * 1.6 * noise1(t * 0.43 + 4, seed + 1), p.head[2] + sway * noise1(t * 0.38, seed + 5)];

  // look: head follows the slow channel, eyes the fast one
  const lh = channel(c.lookH, t, (a, b, k) => ({ p: a.w === 0 ? b.p : b.w === 0 ? a.p : ([lerpN(a.p[0], b.p[0], k), lerpN(a.p[1], b.p[1], k), lerpN(a.p[2], b.p[2], k)] as V3), w: lerpN(a.w, b.w, k) }));
  const le = channel(c.lookE, t, (a, b, k) => ({ p: a.w === 0 ? b.p : b.w === 0 ? a.p : ([lerpN(a.p[0], b.p[0], k), lerpN(a.p[1], b.p[1], k), lerpN(a.p[2], b.p[2], k)] as V3), w: lerpN(a.w, b.w, k) }));
  const follow = channel(c.follow, t, lerpN);
  let headYaw = p.neck[1] + p.head[1], headPitch = p.neck[0] + p.head[0];
  if (lh.w > 0.001) {
    const [yaw0, pitch0] = lookAngles(body, spec, lh.p);
    const yaw = clamp(yaw0, -1.25, 1.25) * follow, pitch = clamp(pitch0, -0.8, 0.8) * follow;
    const w = lh.w;
    p.neck = [lerpN(p.neck[0], body.neck[0] * 0.4 + pitch * 0.35, w), lerpN(p.neck[1], yaw * 0.38, w), p.neck[2]];
    p.head = [lerpN(p.head[0], body.head[0] * 0.4 + pitch * 0.55, w), lerpN(p.head[1], yaw * 0.6, w), p.head[2]];
    headYaw = p.neck[1] + p.head[1];
    headPitch = p.neck[0] + p.head[0];
  }
  if (le.w > 0.001) {
    const [ey, ep] = lookAngles(body, spec, le.p);
    p.face.eyeX = lerpN(p.face.eyeX, clamp(ey - headYaw, -0.6, 0.6), le.w);
    p.face.eyeY = lerpN(p.face.eyeY, clamp(-(ep - headPitch), -0.45, 0.45), le.w);
  }
  const [sx, sy] = saccade(t, sc.nervous, seed);
  p.face.eyeX += sx;
  p.face.eyeY += sy;

  // blinks (not while the eyes are already shut)
  const bl = blinkAt(t, c.blinks, seed) * clamp(p.face.lid / 0.4);
  p.face.lid = p.face.lid * (1 - bl);
  p.face.squint = lerpN(p.face.squint, Math.max(p.face.squint, 0.3), bl);
  if (sg > 0) p.face.lid *= 1 - 0.25 * sg;
  return { pose: p, look: lh.w > 0.5 ? lh.p : null };
};

==== 7920 src/kits/characterflow/character/pose.ts
// Character pose: a plain number tree, computed per frame from film time (no state, no clocks).
// Angles in radians. Conventions (character faces +Z, his left is +X):
//   hips/spine/chest/neck/head [pitch fwd +, yaw to his left +, roll to his left +]
//   legs [swing fwd +, abduct out +, twist], knee bend +, ankle toes-up +
//   arms: FK [swing fwd +, abduct out +, twist] + elbow bend, optionally pulled to an IK target.
// IK targets are written in "chest", "head" or "world" space by presets; the performance resolves
// them to chest space (skeleton.ts) before poses are blended, so blending is always like-for-like.

import { Quaternion } from "three";
import type { V3 } from "./spec.ts";

export type E3 = [number, number, number];
export type IKSpace = "chest" | "head" | "world";

export type Face = {
  /** both brows: +1 raised, −1 lowered */
  browUp: number;
  /** inner brow ends: +1 raised (worry), −1 pulled down (focus/anger) */
  browIn: number;
  /** his left brow up / right down */
  browAsym: number;
  /** upper lids: 1 open, 0 closed, >1 wide */
  lid: number;
  /** lower lid raise (smile squint / tension) 0…1 */
  squint: number;
  /** mouth corners −1 frown … 1 smile */
  smile: number;
  /** mouth open 0…1 */
  open: number;
  /** mouth width −1 pucker … 1 wide/grimace */
  wide: number;
  /** gaze yaw (to his left +) and pitch (up +), radians */
  eyeX: number;
  eyeY: number;
  /** extra blush 0…1 */
  blush: number;
};

export type Hand = { curl: number; index: number; thumb: number; spread: number };
/** `q` optionally fixes the hand orientation (same space as `t`; quaternion x, y, z, w). */
export type IK = { t: V3; space: IKSpace; pole: V3; w: number; q?: [number, number, number, number] };
export type Arm = { sw: number; ab: number; tw: number; el: number; wr: E3; ik?: IK };
/** Legs are FK, or (ik.w ≥ 0.5) planted by IK on a world ankle target with a world foot orientation. */
export type LegIK = { t: V3; q: [number, number, number, number]; w: number };
export type Leg = { sw: number; ab: number; tw: number; kn: number; an: number; ik?: LegIK };

export type Pose = {
  x: number; y: number; z: number; yaw: number;
  hipY: number; hips: E3;
  spine: E3; chest: E3; neck: E3; head: E3;
  /** shoulder shrug 0…1 (both), raises the arm roots */
  shrug: number;
  armL: Arm; armR: Arm;
  legL: Leg; legR: Leg;
  handL: Hand; handR: Hand;
  face: Face;
  /** breathing amplitude (0…1), breaths per second, hand tremble (0…1) */
  breath: number; breathRate: number; tremble: number;
};

export const FACE0: Face = { browUp: 0, browIn: 0, browAsym: 0, lid: 1, squint: 0.1, smile: 0.08, open: 0, wide: 0, eyeX: 0, eyeY: 0, blush: 0 };
export const HAND0: Hand = { curl: 0.35, index: 0.3, thumb: 0.25, spread: 0.1 };

export const arm0 = (): Arm => ({ sw: 0.04, ab: 0.1, tw: 0, el: 0.2, wr: [0, 0, 0] });
export const leg0 = (): Leg => ({ sw: 0, ab: 0.02, tw: 0, kn: 0.04, an: 0 });

export const restPose = (): Pose => ({
  x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, yaw: 0,
  hipY: 0, hips: [0, 0, 0],
  spine: [0, 0, 0], chest: [0, 0, 0], neck: [0, 0, 0], head: [0, 0, 0],
  shrug: 0,
  armL: arm0(), armR: arm0(),
  legL: leg0(), legR: leg0(),
  handL: { ...HAND0 }, handR: { ...HAND0 },
  face: { ...FACE0 },
  breath: 1, breathRate: 0.24, tremble: 0,
});

export const clonePose = (p: Pose): Pose => ({
  ...p,
  hips: [...p.hips], spine: [...p.spine], chest: [...p.chest], neck: [...p.neck], head: [...p.head],
  armL: cloneArm(p.armL), armR: cloneArm(p.armR),
  legL: { ...p.legL }, legR: { ...p.legR },
  handL: { ...p.handL }, handR: { ...p.handR },
  face: { ...p.face },
});
export const cloneArm = (a: Arm): Arm => ({ ...a, wr: [...a.wr], ik: a.ik ? { ...a.ik, t: [...a.ik.t], pole: [...a.ik.pole] } : undefined });

export const lerpN = (a: number, b: number, k: number) => a + (b - a) * k;
export const lerp3 = (a: E3 | V3, b: E3 | V3, k: number): E3 => [lerpN(a[0], b[0], k), lerpN(a[1], b[1], k), lerpN(a[2], b[2], k)];

const slerpQ = (a: IK["q"], b: IK["q"], k: number): IK["q"] => {
  if (!a || !b) return k < 0.5 ? a : b;
  const q = new Quaternion(...a).slerp(new Quaternion(...b), k);
  return [q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w];
};

/** Blend arms. Both IK targets must already be in the same space (the performance resolves to chest). */
export const lerpArm = (a: Arm, b: Arm, k: number): Arm => {
  if (k <= 0) return a;
  if (k >= 1) return b;
  const ia = a.ik, ib = b.ik;
  return {
    sw: lerpN(a.sw, b.sw, k), ab: lerpN(a.ab, b.ab, k), tw: lerpN(a.tw, b.tw, k), el: lerpN(a.el, b.el, k), wr: lerp3(a.wr, b.wr, k),
    ik: ia || ib ? {
      t: lerp3((ia ?? ib)!.t, (ib ?? ia)!.t, k),
      pole: lerp3((ia ?? ib)!.pole, (ib ?? ia)!.pole, k),
      space: (ib ?? ia)!.space,
      w: lerpN(ia?.w ?? 0, ib?.w ?? 0, k),
      q: slerpQ(ia?.q, ib?.q, k),
    } : undefined,
  };
};
export const lerpLeg = (a: Leg, b: Leg, k: number): Leg => {
  const ia = a.ik, ib = b.ik;
  const ik = ia && ib ? { t: lerp3(ia.t, ib.t, k) as V3, q: slerpQ(ia.q, ib.q, k)!, w: lerpN(ia.w, ib.w, k) } : k < 0.5 ? ia : ib;
  return { sw: lerpN(a.sw, b.sw, k), ab: lerpN(a.ab, b.ab, k), tw: lerpN(a.tw, b.tw, k), kn: lerpN(a.kn, b.kn, k), an: lerpN(a.an, b.an, k), ik };
};
export const lerpHand = (a: Hand, b: Hand, k: number): Hand => ({ curl: lerpN(a.curl, b.curl, k), index: lerpN(a.index, b.index, k), thumb: lerpN(a.thumb, b.thumb, k), spread: lerpN(a.spread, b.spread, k) });
export const lerpFace = (a: Face, b: Face, k: number): Face => {
  const o = { ...a };
  for (const key of Object.keys(a) as (keyof Face)[]) o[key] = lerpN(a[key], b[key], k);
  return o;
};

/** Blend two whole poses (yaw the short way round). */
export const blend = (a: Pose, b: Pose, k: number): Pose => {
  if (k <= 0) return a;
  if (k >= 1) return b;
  let dy = b.yaw - a.yaw;
  while (dy > Math.PI) dy -= Math.PI * 2;
  while (dy < -Math.PI) dy += Math.PI * 2;
  return {
    x: lerpN(a.x, b.x, k), y: lerpN(a.y, b.y, k), z: lerpN(a.z, b.z, k), yaw: a.yaw + dy * k,
    hipY: lerpN(a.hipY, b.hipY, k), hips: lerp3(a.hips, b.hips, k),
    spine: lerp3(a.spine, b.spine, k), chest: lerp3(a.chest, b.chest, k), neck: lerp3(a.neck, b.neck, k), head: lerp3(a.head, b.head, k),
    shrug: lerpN(a.shrug, b.shrug, k),
    armL: lerpArm(a.armL, b.armL, k), armR: lerpArm(a.armR, b.armR, k),
    legL: lerpLeg(a.legL, b.legL, k), legR: lerpLeg(a.legR, b.legR, k),
    handL: lerpHand(a.handL, b.handL, k), handR: lerpHand(a.handR, b.handR, k),
    face: lerpFace(a.face, b.face, k),
    breath: lerpN(a.breath, b.breath, k), breathRate: lerpN(a.breathRate, b.breathRate, k), tremble: lerpN(a.tremble, b.tremble, k),
  };
};

const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const D = Math.PI / 180;

/** Walk/run cycle at gait phase `p` (cycles). `amt` scales the stride (1 walk, 1.6 run). */
export const walkCycle = (pose: Pose, p: number, amt = 1): Pose => {
  const o = clonePose(pose);
  const run = Math.max(0, amt - 1);
  const legAt = (ph: number, l: Leg) => {
    const s = Math.sin(TAU * ph), c = Math.cos(TAU * ph);
    l.sw = (22 * D * s) * amt;
    l.kn = (6 * D + (52 + 40 * run) * D * Math.pow(Math.max(0, c), 1.4)) * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.min(1, amt));
    l.an = (10 * D * Math.max(0, c) - 14 * D * Math.max(0, -Math.sin(TAU * ph + 0.9))) * amt;
  };
  legAt(p, o.legL);
  legAt(p + 0.5, o.legR);
  o.hipY = pose.hipY - (0.012 + 0.012 * amt) * (0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(TAU * 2 * p - Math.PI));
  const sway = Math.sin(TAU * p);
  o.hips = [pose.hips[0] + run * 8 * D, pose.hips[1] + 5 * D * sway * amt, pose.hips[2] + 2 * D * Math.cos(TAU * p) * amt];
  o.chest = [pose.chest[0] + run * 6 * D, pose.chest[1] - 7 * D * sway * amt, pose.chest[2]];
  if (!o.armL.ik) { o.armL.sw = pose.armL.sw - 0.32 * sway * amt; o.armL.el = pose.armL.el + 0.12 * amt + run * 0.9; }
  if (!o.armR.ik) { o.armR.sw = pose.armR.sw + 0.32 * sway * amt; o.armR.el = pose.armR.el + 0.12 * amt + run * 0.9; }
  return o;
};

==== 5765 src/kits/characterflow/character/presets/bodies.ts
// Full-body pose presets. A preset is placed by an Anchor:
//   standing poses — a floor point, facing `yaw`;
//   bed poses      — a point on the mattress top under the pelvis, `yaw` = direction toward the feet.
// Arms here are only defaults; gestures (gestures.ts) override them per beat.

import { arm0, clonePose, restPose, walkCycle, type Pose } from "../pose.ts";
import { DIMS, type CharacterSpec } from "../spec.ts";

export type Anchor = { x: number; y: number; z: number; yaw: number };

const D = Math.PI / 180;

const at = (p: Pose, a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec, pelvisLift: number) => {
  p.x = a.x;
  p.z = a.z;
  p.yaw = a.yaw;
  p.y = a.y + pelvisLift - DIMS.pelvisH * spec.scale;
  return p;
};

export type BodyFn = (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec, t: number) => Pose;

export const BODY: Record<
  "stand" | "standSlump" | "standCower" | "standProud" | "run" | "lie" | "sit" | "sitHunch" | "sitWrite" | "sitReachRight" | "lieReachRight",
  BodyFn
> = {
  stand: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = restPose();
    p.legL.kn = p.legR.kn = 0.05;
    p.legL.ab = p.legR.ab = 0.035;
    p.armL = { ...arm0(), sw: 0.02, ab: 0.12, el: 0.22 };
    p.armR = { ...arm0(), sw: 0.04, ab: 0.11, el: 0.26 };
    p.hips = [0, 0, 1.5 * D];
    p.chest = [-2 * D, 0, -1 * D];
    return at(p, a, spec, DIMS.pelvisH * spec.scale);
  },

  standSlump: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = BODY.stand(a, spec, 0);
    p.spine = [8 * D, 0, 0];
    p.chest = [14 * D, 0, 0];
    p.neck = [14 * D, 0, 0];
    p.head = [10 * D, 0, 0];
    p.shrug = 0.3;
    p.legL.kn = p.legR.kn = 0.12;
    p.hipY = -0.02;
    return p;
  },

  standCower: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = BODY.stand(a, spec, 0);
    p.hipY = -0.08;
    p.legL.kn = p.legR.kn = 0.4;
    p.legL.sw = p.legR.sw = 0.2;
    p.legL.an = p.legR.an = 0.18;
    p.spine = [14 * D, 0, 0];
    p.chest = [16 * D, 0, 0];
    p.neck = [10 * D, 0, 0];
    p.head = [16 * D, 0, 0];
    p.shrug = 0.8;
    return p;
  },

  standProud: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = BODY.stand(a, spec, 0);
    p.chest = [-7 * D, 0, 0];
    p.head = [-6 * D, 0, 0];
    p.hipY = 0.005;
    return p;
  },

  run: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec, t: number) => {
    const p = BODY.stand(a, spec, 0);
    p.spine = [10 * D, 0, 0];
    p.armL = { ...p.armL, el: 0.9 };
    p.armR = { ...p.armR, el: 0.9 };
    return walkCycle(p, t * 1.7, 1.55);
  },

  /** On his back in bed, head on the pillow, arms along the body. */
  lie: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = restPose();
    p.hips = [-90 * D, 0, 0];
    p.spine = [-3 * D, 0, 0];
    p.chest = [-4 * D, 0, 0];
    p.neck = [24 * D, 0, 0];
    p.head = [12 * D, 0, 0];
    p.legL = { sw: 1 * D, ab: 3 * D, tw: 6 * D, kn: 5 * D, an: -26 * D };
    p.legR = { sw: 1 * D, ab: 4 * D, tw: 8 * D, kn: 6 * D, an: -24 * D };
    p.armL = { ...arm0(), sw: 6 * D, ab: 14 * D, el: 0.32 };
    p.armR = { ...arm0(), sw: 6 * D, ab: 14 * D, el: 0.32 };
    p.breath = 0.8;
    p.breathRate = 0.2;
    return at(p, a, spec, 0.105);
  },

  /** Sitting up in bed, legs straight under the blanket, a soft slouch. */
  sit: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = restPose();
    const lean = -9 * D;
    p.hips = [lean, 0, 0];
    p.spine = [6 * D, 0, 0];
    p.chest = [7 * D, 0, 0];
    p.neck = [4 * D, 0, 0];
    p.head = [3 * D, 0, 0];
    p.legL = { sw: Math.PI / 2 + lean - 1 * D, ab: 4 * D, tw: 4 * D, kn: 7 * D, an: -30 * D };
    p.legR = { sw: Math.PI / 2 + lean - 2 * D, ab: 5 * D, tw: 6 * D, kn: 9 * D, an: -28 * D };
    p.armL = { ...arm0(), sw: 0.3, ab: 0.16, el: 0.7 };
    p.armR = { ...arm0(), sw: 0.3, ab: 0.16, el: 0.7 };
    return at(p, a, spec, 0.1);
  },

  /** Curled forward over the lap — overwhelmed. */
  sitHunch: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = BODY.sit(a, spec, 0);
    p.hips = [2 * D, 0, 0];
    p.legL.sw = Math.PI / 2 + 2 * D - 1 * D;
    p.legR.sw = Math.PI / 2 + 2 * D - 2 * D;
    p.legL.kn = p.legR.kn = 14 * D;
    p.spine = [16 * D, 0, 0];
    p.chest = [20 * D, 0, 0];
    p.neck = [16 * D, 0, 0];
    p.head = [16 * D, 0, 0];
    p.shrug = 0.55;
    return p;
  },

  /** Sitting tall, looking down at the lap (reading / writing). */
  sitWrite: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = BODY.sit(a, spec, 0);
    p.hips = [-4 * D, 0, 0];
    p.legL.sw = Math.PI / 2 - 4 * D - 1 * D;
    p.legR.sw = Math.PI / 2 - 4 * D - 2 * D;
    p.spine = [9 * D, 0, 0];
    p.chest = [11 * D, 3 * D, 0];
    p.neck = [18 * D, 0, 0];
    p.head = [16 * D, 0, 0];
    return p;
  },

  /** Sitting, leaning out to his right (toward a nightstand on that side). */
  sitReachRight: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = BODY.sit(a, spec, 0);
    // twist distributed low (hips/spine) so the shirt hem never swings out of the waist
    p.hips = [-2 * D, -12 * D, -8 * D];
    p.legL.sw = Math.PI / 2 - 2 * D;
    p.legR.sw = Math.PI / 2 - 3 * D;
    p.spine = [12 * D, -16 * D, -14 * D];
    p.chest = [8 * D, -5 * D, -5 * D];
    p.neck = [10 * D, -12 * D, 0];
    p.head = [12 * D, -8 * D, 4 * D];
    return p;
  },

  /** Lying, rolled a little to his right to reach the nightstand. */
  lieReachRight: (a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec) => {
    const p = BODY.lie(a, spec, 0);
    p.hips = [-90 * D, 0, -11 * D];
    p.spine = [-2 * D, -6 * D, -9 * D];
    p.chest = [-3 * D, -3 * D, -3 * D];
    p.neck = [18 * D, -22 * D, 0];
    p.head = [8 * D, -18 * D, 0];
    return p;
  },
};

export type BodyName = keyof typeof BODY;

/** Clone a preset result so beats can tweak it safely. */
export const bodyPose = (name: BodyName, a: Anchor, spec: CharacterSpec, t: number) => clonePose(BODY[name](a, spec, t));

==== 6627 src/kits/characterflow/character/presets/gestures.ts
// Arm + hand gesture presets, written for his LEFT arm; the rig mirrors them for the right
// (FK by side, chest/head IK targets by x). World-space targets (reaching for a prop) are not
// mirrored — build those with `reach()` at performance time.
// IK targets are wrist positions; chest space is in rig metres, head space in head units.

import { arm0, HAND0, type Arm, type Hand, type IK } from "../pose.ts";
import type { V3 } from "../spec.ts";

export type Gesture = { arm: Arm; hand: Hand };

const hand = (o: Partial<Hand>): Hand => ({ ...HAND0, ...o });
export const HANDS = {
  relaxed: hand({}),
  soft: hand({ curl: 0.25, index: 0.2, thumb: 0.2, spread: 0.15 }),
  open: hand({ curl: 0.06, index: 0.04, thumb: 0.05, spread: 0.6 }),
  fist: hand({ curl: 1.05, index: 1.0, thumb: 0.9, spread: 0 }),
  grip: hand({ curl: 0.72, index: 0.62, thumb: 0.65, spread: 0.05 }),
  pen: hand({ curl: 0.85, index: 0.45, thumb: 0.7, spread: 0 }),
  point: hand({ curl: 1.0, index: 0.0, thumb: 0.8, spread: 0 }),
  claw: hand({ curl: 0.55, index: 0.5, thumb: 0.4, spread: 0.7 }),
  flat: hand({ curl: 0.08, index: 0.06, thumb: 0.12, spread: 0.12 }),
};

const ik = (t: V3, space: IK["space"], pole: V3, w = 1): IK => ({ t, space, pole, w });
const fk = (o: Partial<Arm>): Arm => ({ ...arm0(), ...o });
const g = (arm: Arm, h: Hand): Gesture => ({ arm, hand: h });

export const GESTURE = {
  rest: g(fk({}), HANDS.relaxed),
  hangLoose: g(fk({ sw: 0.02, ab: 0.06, el: 0.12 }), HANDS.soft),
  /** lying: arm along the body on top of the blanket */
  lieSide: g(fk({ sw: 0.1, ab: 0.24, el: 0.3, wr: [0, 0, 0.2] }), HANDS.soft),
  /** sitting: hand resting on the thigh */
  onLap: g(fk({ wr: [0.35, 0, 0.25], ik: ik([0.14, -0.27, 0.27], "chest", [1, -0.3, -0.6]) }), HANDS.soft),
  /** hands meeting over the lap, fingers fidgeting */
  clasp: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.05, -0.26, 0.31], "chest", [1, -0.5, -0.4]), wr: [0.2, 0.3, 0.5] }), HANDS.grip),
  /** palm flat on the chest (calming breath) */
  onChest: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.1, -0.06, 0.2], "chest", [1, -1, -0.2]), wr: [-0.3, 0.2, 1.25] }), HANDS.flat),
  onBelly: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.05, -0.2, 0.25], "chest", [1, -0.9, 0]), wr: [0, 0, 0.8] }), HANDS.flat),
  /** fingertips to the temple — "wait, what did I say?" */
  temple: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.14, -0.075, 0.075], "head", [0.6, -0.6, 1]), wr: [0, 0.2, -0.25] }), hand({ curl: 0.35, index: 0.12, thumb: 0.5, spread: 0.2 })),
  /** rubbing the back of the neck */
  rubNeck: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.07, -0.2, -0.13], "head", [1, 0.45, 0.25]), wr: [0.4, 0, -0.6] }), HANDS.soft),
  /** chin on the knuckles — thinking */
  chin: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.01, -0.15, 0.1], "head", [1, -1, 0.3]), wr: [0, 0, 0.5] }), HANDS.fist),
  /** both hands over the face/temples — overwhelmed (use on both arms) */
  headInHands: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.105, -0.12, 0.085], "head", [0.8, -1, 0.4]), wr: [0, 0.55, 0.15] }), HANDS.claw),
  /** fingers in the hair above the ears */
  grabHair: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.125, -0.02, -0.02], "head", [1, -0.2, 0.2]), wr: [0, 0.5, -0.4] }), HANDS.claw),
  /** palm up shrug */
  palmUp: g(fk({ sw: 0.42, ab: 0.34, tw: 0.9, el: 1.35, wr: [0, 0, -0.35] }), HANDS.open),
  /** open explaining hand, forearm forward */
  explain: g(fk({ sw: 0.55, ab: 0.22, tw: 0.6, el: 1.25, wr: [-0.2, 0, -0.2] }), HANDS.open),
  point: g(fk({ sw: 1.25, ab: 0.18, tw: 0.2, el: 0.15, wr: [0, 0, 0] }), HANDS.point),
  pointUp: g(fk({ sw: 0.5, ab: 0.2, tw: 0.3, el: 1.9, wr: [0, 0, 0] }), HANDS.point),
  crossArms: g(fk({ ik: ik([-0.1, -0.06, 0.2], "chest", [1, -1, 0.2]), wr: [0, 0, 0.6] }), HANDS.flat),
  /** hand behind the head — relaxed, lying or leaning */
  behindHead: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.085, 0.02, -0.15], "head", [1, 1.2, -0.4]), wr: [0, 0, -0.3] }), HANDS.soft),
  /** cover mouth (embarrassed / shock) */
  coverMouth: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.03, -0.21, 0.13], "head", [1, -1, 0.2]), wr: [0, 0.3, 0.9] }), HANDS.flat),
  /** holding a book/notebook in front of the body (left hand under it) */
  holdBook: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.05, -0.29, 0.36], "chest", [1, -1, -0.2]), wr: [0.25, 0, 0.6] }), HANDS.grip),
  wave: g(fk({ sw: 0.3, ab: 0.9, tw: 0.4, el: 1.7, wr: [0, 0, 0] }), HANDS.open),
  /** a greeting that stops halfway (hand at chest height, unsure) */
  halfWave: g(fk({ sw: 0.62, ab: 0.42, tw: 0.55, el: 1.75, wr: [0.1, 0, -0.2] }), hand({ curl: 0.22, index: 0.12, thumb: 0.2, spread: 0.45 })),
  /** hand into the trouser pocket (same side) */
  pocket: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.15, -0.44, 0.06], "chest", [1, 0.3, -0.6]), wr: [0, 0, 0.3] }), HANDS.grip),
  /** palm over the eyes and forehead — "aduh" */
  facepalm: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.035, -0.035, 0.165], "head", [1, -1.2, 0.25]), wr: [-0.1, 0.15, 0.2] }), HANDS.flat),
  /** index finger at his own chest — "me?" */
  pointSelf: g(fk({ ik: ik([-0.04, -0.06, 0.24], "chest", [1, -1, 0]), wr: [0, 0, 0.4] }), HANDS.point),
  thumbsUp: g(fk({ sw: 0.95, ab: 0.25, tw: 0.9, el: 1.5, wr: [0, 0, -0.3] }), hand({ curl: 1.05, index: 1.0, thumb: 0, spread: 0 })),
  /** scratching the side of the head — confused */
  scratchHead: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.115, 0.02, -0.02], "head", [1, 0.3, 0.3]), wr: [0, 0.3, -0.5] }), HANDS.claw),
  /** hands on hips — confident / waiting */
  onHip: g(fk({ ik: ik([0.2, -0.38, 0.02], "chest", [1, 0.2, -1]), wr: [0, 0, 1.2] }), HANDS.fist),
  /** pointing forward at something / someone */
  pointFwd: g(fk({ sw: 1.3, ab: 0.12, tw: 0.15, el: 0.15, wr: [0, 0, 0] }), HANDS.point),
};

/** Talking with the hands: an explaining hand that moves in small beats. */
export const explaining = (rate = 1.3) => (t: number): Gesture => ({
  arm: fk({ sw: 0.55 + 0.12 * Math.sin(t * rate * 6.3), ab: 0.22, tw: 0.6, el: 1.25 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * rate * 6.3 + 1), wr: [-0.2, 0, -0.2] }),
  hand: HANDS.open,
});

/** Hello wave that keeps waving (rate in waves per second). */
export const waving = (rate = 2.2, size = 1) => (t: number): Gesture => ({
  arm: fk({ sw: 0.3, ab: 0.95 + 0.2 * size * Math.sin(t * rate * Math.PI * 2), tw: 0.4, el: 1.6 + 0.18 * size * Math.sin(t * rate * Math.PI * 2 + 1.1) }),
  hand: HANDS.open,
});

/** High five toward a world point (open palm forward). */
export const highFive = (p: V3, pole: V3 = [1, -0.5, -0.3]): Gesture => ({ arm: { ...arm0(), wr: [-0.6, 0, 0], ik: { t: p, space: "world", pole, w: 1 } }, hand: HANDS.open });

export type GestureName = keyof typeof GESTURE;

/** Wrist IK toward a world point (props, switches). */
export const reach = (t: V3, pole: V3 = [1, -0.6, -0.4], hnd: Hand = HANDS.grip, wr: Arm["wr"] = [0, 0, 0]): Gesture => ({
  arm: { ...arm0(), wr, ik: { t, space: "world", pole, w: 1 } },
  hand: hnd,
});
